github.name: Malik1942/CalmMouse
github.description: Magic Mouse fixes for macOS: the page stops scrolling when you click. Plus smooth scrolling for wheel mice and a game controller as a mouse.

projects.summary: 妙控鼠标的整个上表面都是触控区，按下去时手指的轻微滑动会被当成滚动，于是页面在点击生效前先动了一下，点错按钮、拖错图层很常见。CalmMouse 是一个 macOS 菜单栏小工具，只在按键按下时拦住这点滚动，其它时候一切照常，触控板不受影响。新版也能让普通滚轮鼠标平滑滚动、单独设置方向，还能把 PS5 手柄的触控板当触控板用。 亮点 只解决一个具体的痛点：系统设置里没有这个开关；能处理它的 BetterTouchTool 是付费软件，Mac Mouse Fix 这类免费工具不支持妙控鼠标。 设置窗口里指向任意一项，左边渲染的鼠标就会演示这项设置的效果，不用读说明。 按 App 单独设置，比如在 Figma 里完全关掉妙控鼠标滚动，在浏览器里照常。 原生 Swift，用 CGEventTap 区分是哪个设备发出的滚动，手势状态机有单元测试，适合想了解 macOS 事件处理的人读源码。 免费、MIT 开源，已签名公证，简体中文、繁体中文、英文界面，支持 Homebrew 安装。

projects.title: AppmanCC
projects.summary: AppmanCC is the developer toolkit that lives next to your clipboard. Paste anything — a hash, a token, a blob of JSON, a URL — and AppmanCC recognizes it and shows the result instantly. No accounts, no tracking. ONE PASTE, THE RIGHT TOOL • Copy something, open AppmanCC and tap Paste. JSON, JWTs, hashes, UUIDs, timestamps, URLs and Base64 are detected automatically. • Results slide up from the bottom while your input stays on screen. Edit the input and the result updates as you type.

projects.title: TrackFinder
projects.summary: Free desktop app for Windows and macOS. Type a DJ’s name and a period: TrackFinder finds their sets on 1001Tracklists and lists every track they played, without IDs, unreleased tracks or duplicates...

projects.title: Termilly
projects.summary: Termilly is built with productivity in mind. Keep each project's terminals together, with splits and tabs. Terminals come back after a restart, with their output. Run native ps, cmd, bash as well as Claude Code and Codex sessions and see which one is working or done. Use your terminals from your phone or another PC. Search any command or output, even in closed terminals. Git, files, snippets, clipboard history and notes next to your terminals. Control terminals from scripts or AI agents.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】TimeFloat：一个原生离线的 macOS 悬浮时钟
projects.author: wayss000
projects.summary: 阮老师好，想自荐一个我做的 macOS 开源小工具 TimeFloat，一个常驻菜单栏的悬浮时钟。 打开后只在桌面上显示一张时钟卡片，不占 Dock，需要看时间时抬眼就能看到。应用完全离线运行，无账号、无服务器、无第三方依赖，安装包只有约 58 KB。使用 Swift 与 SwiftUI/AppKit 原生开发，支持 macOS 13 及以上，Apple Silicon 和 Intel 都提供对应的安装包。 拖动卡片可以移动位置，拖四边或四角能按比例缩放；点击菜单栏的时钟图标可以显示/隐藏时钟、切换 12/24 小时制、置顶或退出。 源代码（MIT）

projects.title: WorkoutGPX
projects.summary: Turn GPS-tracked Apple Health workouts into standard GPX files on iPhone and iPad. Export one workout, selected workouts or a filtered history, with timestamps, elevation and recorded sensor data such as heart rate, cadence and power. Hide the start and end of routes before sharing, or automate exports with Shortcuts. Free, with no account, servers or analytics; processing stays on your device.

projects.title: Spellar for Chrome
projects.summary: Spellar for Chrome takes no-bot meeting notes on Windows and Mac, right in your browser, with no desktop app to install. It records Google Meet, Zoom, Teams and Webex, and nothing joins the call. On Google Meet, transcripts show real speaker names. Every call goes into one memory with your Spellar Mac and iPhone notes, so you can ask what a client said three calls ago. Send notes to Slack or Notion and pick Claude, GPT or Gemini. Start with 300 free minutes, no card needed.

projects.title: hi day
projects.summary: Time tracking for teams: track time, projects and activity in the desktop app and on the web. Your team sees exactly what managers see.

projects.title: 【软件自荐】Headphone Control：在 Mac 菜单栏里切换索尼耳机的降噪、EQ 和查看电量
projects.author: gbpusddom6ci
projects.summary: 自荐一个我自己做的 macOS 菜单栏小工具 Headphone Control（免费，目前是 TestFlight 公测版）。

projects.title: Mistral Vibe Desktop
projects.summary: Vibe is Mistral's AI agent for work and code (formerly Le Chat), and it now has a desktop app for macOS and Windows. Run coding agents locally or remotely, brief it on long-horizon tasks and keep working while it ships. You can import projects and sessions from another coding agent during setup. Vibe is also in the terminal, VS Code, web, iOS, Android and Slack. Building in Europe? Try the Pro plan free with code LECHONK.

projects.title: Fieldwork Code
projects.summary: Run parallel AI coding sessions with your choice of harness (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi or Fieldwork's own) and model, locally via our desktop app (free) or in cloud sandboxes ($50/mo). Pick up any session from the web or the Fieldwork mobile app. A side pane gives you a terminal, file diffs, PR status and CI checks, plus one-click instructions and inline diff reviews for your agent. Built on Fieldwork, so it comes with 3,000+ connectors, tasks and a knowledge base.

projects.title: 【软件自荐】RockDesk（磐石远控）：一个 ID 连上另一台电脑，Claude Code 也能直接操作它
projects.author: rockdesk-io
projects.summary: （海外： 我们做的远程访问工具。每台设备一个 9 位 ID，不要公网 IP、不用开端口：能打洞就点对点直连，打不通自动走中继。 一条连接里都有：远程桌面、终端、传文件、挂目录、端口转发、内网穿透、剪贴板。 给 AI 用，说话指挥就行：自带命令行 rds，在 Claude Code 里说一句「Install the skill at Claude 去调试机器人小车的底盘、在 GPU 机器上训练模型。 平台：Windows、macOS（Apple 芯片 / Intel）、Linux（.deb，x8664 / arm64，服务器、板子这种没界面的也能装）、安卓；iPhone / iPad 用 App Store 的「RockDesk Remote」（免费）连电脑；也有网页版，不用装。 安全：每台设备有自己的证书，连接端到端加密，走中继时服务器转发的也是密文；谁能连、能用哪些功能，由被连的那台决定。 其他说明：商业软件，可以免费试用；闭源。有问题发 support@rockdesk.io。

projects.title: DataRay
projects.summary: DataRay brings SQL and APIs into one native desktop app. Send requests, inspect database results, import Postman collections and edit SQL with teammates in real time. Built with Rust and GPUI for macOS and Windows.

projects.title: Alfred 6
projects.summary: Alfred 6 brings Alfred UI, a new macOS-native toolkit creators can use to build lightweight workflows with real interfaces. Plus a fresh look across themes and preferences, a new Query History, and extended Clipboard History. Built for lightweight efficiency, stability and speed.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】一个开源的原生截图工具，体积只有 1–2 MB，支持标注、长截图、OCR 和录屏。它提供 Node-API 插件和 C SDK，可以集成到 Electron 和其他桌面应用中。
projects.author: imjakey

github.name: imjakey/shotlet
github.description: Native screenshot & recording tool for Windows and macOS, with scrolling capture, annotations, OCR, editable history, and Electron integration. 面向 Windows 和 macOS 的原生截图与录屏工具，支持滚动长截图、丰富标注、OCR、历史截图再编辑及 Electron 集成。

projects.summary: 阮老师好，我开发了一个开源截图工具 Shotlet，想推荐给周刊。

projects.title: Equalizer Bar
projects.summary: Shape your Mac's sound from the menu bar. Equalizer Bar processes audio from your Mac's selected system output in real time. Choose a sound mode with one click, or build your own sound with a 10-band equalizer. Audio is processed locally on your Mac. Equalizer Bar does not save audio recordings or send audio to a server. macOS asks for System Audio Recording permission when you turn on processing. Turn it off at any time to return to normal playback. Requires macOS 14.2 or later.

projects.title: Skill Stow：一个尽量做得清晰、顺手的 macOS AI Skill 管理器
projects.author: dbaazz

github.name: DBAAZzz/skill-stow
github.description: Mac app for the skills of every AI agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and 28 more): security check before install, per-agent on/off, updates with a diff, usage stats. Free, offline, no telemetry.

projects.summary: 平时用 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI 这些工具多了，本地 `~/.claude`、`~/.codex`、`~/.cursor` 和各个项目里的 Skill 目录很容易越堆越乱。 其实市面上已经有现成的 Skill 管理器了，功能上大家也都大差不差。我自己又重写一个 **Skill Stow**，主要出发点不是"发明什么新功能"，而是想做一款**自己每天打开都觉得舒服**的工具： 1. **信息足够清晰**：哪个 Skill 装在公共库、哪个是某个 Agent 独有、哪个只在当前项目生效，一眼就能看明白，不要一打开全是噪音。 2. **交互逻辑顺直**：尽量按桌面端直觉走，减少莫名其妙的跳转和割裂感。 3. **UI 和动效细节**：基于 **Go + MyGo** 做的 macOS 原生界面（不是 Web 套壳），在排版、配色（支持浅色/深色）、过渡动画和快捷键上花了不少时间打磨。 ### 顺便带过一下核心能力 - **统一视图**：扫描本机 32 个常见 Agent 目录和项目历史，支持卡片 / 按 Agent 分列看板两种视图。 - **按 Agent 开关**：直接开关 Claude Code / Codex / Gemini CLI / OpenCode / ZCode 的配置，或软链到其他 Agent。 - **导入与本地安全检查**：支持 GitHub 链接、`npx skills add` 命令、本地文件夹 / `.zip` 拖入；导入前会先做一遍本地离线扫描（并展示 skills.sh 审计结果）。 - **可控更新与整理**：GitHub 来源的 Skill 支持看 file-by-file diff 再更新，默认保留旧版到废纸篓；支持一键合并重复副本、对比差异、清理失效软链。 - **使用统计 & 原生体验**：读取本地 Claude Code / Codex 日志看调用频率；支持 `⌘K` 全局搜索（中文支持拼音）、磁盘实时监听、`⌘Z` 撤销删除。 ### 下载与开源地址 - GitHub：https://github.com/DBAAZzz/skill-stow - Release 下载：https://github.com/DBAAZzz/skill-stow/releases/latest - 演示视频：（这里可以贴你刚传好的 YouTube 链接） **说明**： - **MIT 开源免费**，纯本地运行，无账号、无遥测。 - 支持 **macOS 12+**（Universal 包，Apple Silicon / Intel 通用）。 - 目前还没有 Apple Developer ID 签名，首次打开如果被 Gatekeeper 拦截，在「系统设置 -> 隐私与安全性」里点「仍要打开」，或看下 README 里的 `xattr` 放行命令即可。 做这个项目的初衷就是自己用着顺手，顺便开源出来，欢迎提 Issue 或聊聊交互上的建议。 ![主界面](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/DBAAZzz/skill-stow@main/docs/screenshots/zh/main.png) ![看板视图](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/DBAAZzz/skill-stow@main/docs/screenshots/zh/board.png) ![添加技能](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/DBAAZzz/skill-stow@main/docs/screenshots/zh/add.png) ![安全检查](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/DBAAZzz/skill-stow@main/docs/screenshots/zh/security.png) ![技能更新](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/DBAAZzz/skill-stow@main/docs/screenshots/zh/updates.png) ![整理中心](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/DBAAZzz/skill-stow@main/docs/screenshots/zh/tidy.png) ![副本对比](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/DBAAZzz/skill-stow@main/docs/screenshots/zh/compare.png) ![使用统计](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/DBAAZzz/skill-stow@main/docs/screenshots/zh/usage.png) ![全局搜索](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/DBAAZzz/skill-stow@main/docs/screenshots/zh/search.png)

projects.title: ScreenSky
projects.summary: ScreenSky is a native Mac app that helps you take regular screen breaks and pick up where you left off. Set your own break intervals, capture tasks with a shortcut, and show your next task during a break. Smart Pause can hold the timer during calls and presentations. Optional posture and blink reminders run on their own schedule. Tasks and notes stay on your Mac.

projects.title: 【工具自荐】Inkmap（墨图）：支持逐字节写回本地 .md 的双向 Markdown 思维导图与 Mermaid 编辑器
projects.author: zhiyuanvision-lang

github.name: zhiyuanvision-lang/InkMap
github.description: Editable Markmap alternative: Two-way Markdown Mind Map & Mermaid Flowchart Editor for VS Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop, Codex & MCP Apps (npx -y inkmap-mcp)

projects.summary: 阮老师好，自荐一个刚开发的本地优先效率工具 Inkmap（墨图）。 很多开发者和笔记用户喜欢用 Markmap 把 Markdown 渲染成思维导图，但一直有个痛点：Markmap 只能单向只读预览，没法像 XMind / 飞书脑图一样直接在画布上增删、拖拽修改节点；而换用传统思维导图软件，文件又变成了私有格式，Git 没法 diff，AI 智能体也没法直接读写。 Inkmap 让文件始终保持为普通本地 .md，同时提供完整的双向画布编辑能力： 逐字节无损双向同步：在画布上按 Tab / Enter 增删、拖拽重组节点，底层 .md 实时自动写回，未修改段落逐字节原样保留，Git diff 干净；左侧改 .md 源码，右侧导图毫秒级刷新并双向定位行号。 节点内嵌 Mermaid 流程图与 LaTeX 公式：在导图分支内直接高清渲染 Mermaid 流程图/时序图/状态图、LaTeX 公式与 Markdown 表格，支持一键编辑图表源码。 9 种专业结构 + 深色护眼主题 + 逐节点放映：支持逻辑图、左右脑图、组织结构图、时间轴、鱼骨图，一键导出高清 PNG / 矢量 SVG / 离线交互 HTML。 多编辑器与 MCP App 接入：支持 VS Code、Cursor、Trae、DeepSeek Harness、Claude Desktop/Code、Codex、Qoder 等（一行 npx -y inkmap-mcp@latest install 自动配置）。 动态演示 相关链接 免安装在线试玩（Playground）： GitHub VS Code / Cursor 插件市场：

projects.title: CopyNHoard
projects.summary: Windows' own clipboard history keeps 25 items and clears them on restart. CopyNHoard keeps up to 2,000: text, code, links, colors, screenshots and files, for anyone who copies and pastes all day. Press Ctrl+Alt+V over any app, type a few letters (typos are fine, and it finds words inside screenshots) and Enter pastes where you were typing. Paste several clips in order, one per Ctrl+V. Passwords and API keys are never saved, and your history never leaves your PC. Pay once, no subscription.

projects.title: Spaces Utility
projects.summary: Give your Mac desktops names like Writing, Research, and Admin. See those names in Mission Control and when you switch Spaces. Open Workstation Overview from the menu bar to see which apps are on each display and jump straight to a desktop or app window. For Apple silicon Macs on macOS 27.2 or later. Try it free for 7 days, no card required, then pay €9.99 once.

projects.title: Warden
projects.summary: A free desktop app and browser extension that checks every Solana transaction and message before your wallet signs it. It runs the transaction on your own computer, says in plain words what would happen, and blocks drainers, phishing sites and address poisoning. Works with Phantom, Solflare and Backpack.

projects.title: Pi Bot 上线了！
projects.author: leen0zhou
projects.summary: 大家好，我做了一个桌面应用 Pi Bot。可以给写代码、做调研、写文档的 Bot 分别设角色和模型，再让它们在同一个群里分工。比如让一个 Bot 做调研、交一份资料，另一个接着写报告。过程中谁做了什么、改了哪些文件，都能回头看。 第一版目前有这些功能： - Bot 和群协作：可以单聊、拉群、`@` 指定成员。复杂任务由统筹 Bot 拆成几步，列出负责人、依赖和交付物。你可以先看计划，再决定是否执行。 - 在指定文件夹里干活：Bot 可以读写文件、跑命令、打开内置浏览器。可以查看文件差异、撤回改动，或者请另一个 Bot 独立审查。每轮有工作收据，能看到命令、审批和交付物。 - 接入已有的 Agent：可以把已安装的 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor 或 OpenCode 加为 Bot，让它接群任务或例行任务。 - 例行任务和待办：支持定时、只跑一次、文件夹变化等触发方式。任务可以先试跑，再设置本任务的预授权。个人待办可以用列表或日历看。 - 模型和扩展：每个 Bot 可以用不同模型。支持云模型 API、Ollama、LM Studio 和自定义网关。可以导入 MCP、技能和插件，也能把 Obsidian 或 Notion 接成只读知识库。 - Android 和远程执行：手机扫码配对后可以发任务、看结果、处理审批。也可以给另一台电脑或服务器装 Runner，让 Bot 在那台机器的指定目录里工作。 - 权限和数据：可以分开设置 Bot 和群的权限。macOS 和 Linux 支持命令沙箱。聊天记录、记忆和操作记录默认保存在本机，使用云模型时，相关请求会发给你选择的服务商。 桌面端有 macOS、Windows、Linux，手机端目前提供 Android APK。Apple 芯片版也可以下载，官网标为「未实机测试」。 官网下载：https://pibot.space/

projects.title: Superclip
projects.summary: Superclip brings clipboard history, music controls, video, focus tools and AI usage into a compact Windows notch or side panel. Find copied text, links, images and more without hunting through windows. Your clipboard history stays on your PC. One-time purchase; Mac version coming soon.

projects.title: Getman
projects.summary: Getman is a free, open-source alternative to Postman. Every request is a plain YAML file in your repo, so API changes get reviewed in the same pull request as the code. Send them from the desktop app, your phone, a browser, the terminal or CI. HTTP/1.1 to HTTP/3, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSocket, SSE and Socket.IO. Import your Postman collections and most pm scripts run as they are. Free for any team size, with no account, no per-seat plan and no telemetry.

projects.title: PEARSPECTIVE
projects.summary: Desktop app for photographers that finds the venues, events and brands who need photos, writes each pitch in the photographer's voice, and handles proposals, contracts, deposit invoices, calendar and galleries.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】AGASTHY：看清开发机上的仓库、依赖和 AI 编程 Agent，删除前先知道会影响什么
projects.author: HMAKT99

github.name: HMAKT99/Agasthy
github.description: One intelligence layer for your developer machine. Every repo, runtime, package and AI tool in a live knowledge graph. Track coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor), token spend, MCP servers and processes. Impact analysis, safe disk cleanup, security checks, ask-your-machine AI. Local-first. Mac-first · Windows preview · Linux from source.

projects.summary: AGASTHY： 一个开源的桌面应用，把整台开发机连成一张图：本机的 Git 仓库（包括未提交的改动）、各语言运行时（哪个 python / node 真正生效，哪些被遮蔽了）、Homebrew / npm / pip 等装的包、AI 工具和 MCP 服务器，全部关联到一张知识图谱里，每条信息都注明来源。 几个主要功能： 删除前先看影响：比如卸载 openssl@3，会列出哪些项目会坏、哪些会退回到另一个已安装的版本，并给出恢复方法。 AI 编程 Agent 面板：同时开着 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、Hermes 时，看每个会话占多少内存、启动了哪些 MCP 服务器和 dev server，以及 Agent 退出后还在跑、还占着端口的进程。 Token 用量：从各 Agent 自己的本地日志读取（只读计数，不读对话内容），按天、项目和模型统计，并按 API 公开价格估算成本。 安全清理：只清理被 Git 忽略、可以重新生成的目录（nodemodules、target 等），先移进可恢复的隔离区；任何操作都先 dry run，确认后才执行。 做它是因为同时跑多个编程 Agent 以后，机器上多了很多看不见的东西：没人关的 dev server、每个几百 MB 的 Agent 进程、重复的依赖和缓存。我的 Mac 上同时开着 6 个 Claude Code 会话，一共占了 1.7 GB 内存。现有工具要么只管磁盘，要么只看进程，没有一个能说清这些东西之间的关系，以及删掉某个东西会影响什么。 它也能给 Agent 用：自带只读的命令行工具和 MCP 服务器（9 个工具），Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenClaw、Hermes 可以直接问「哪些项目有未提交的改动」「3000 端口被谁占了」「这周 Agent 花了多少 token」。 本地优先：不需要账号，没有遥测，数据只存在本机的一个 SQLite 文件里。Rust + Tauri，Apache-2.0 协议。主要支持 macOS（Apple 芯片），Windows 和 Linux 是预览版。README 顶部有一分钟的演示视频。 我是作者。

projects.title: Christmasify
projects.summary: Christmasify turns your whole Mac into Christmas. Snow falls and piles up on top of your windows, and slides off when you move one. Glass bulb lights twinkle under the menu bar. Santa is stuck in the notch, a reindeer nibbles your menu bar icons and a little steam train goes by. Step away and frost creeps in; after dark the northern lights come out. Clicks go straight through, so it never gets in your way. Free for a day, then $4.99 once.

projects.title: Lantern
projects.summary: Lantern maps your codebase into a graph, helps you plan changes, reviews pull requests with generated flows and diffs in review order, and watches all your Claude Code and Codex sessions in one desktop app. Open source, local-first, MIT.

projects.title: Zuturno
projects.summary: Zuturno keeps your PC or Mac active while you step away, preventing sleep, screen locking and session interruptions. Choose the actions (mouse, scroll, clicks, app and browser tab switching) and the activity level, then start or stop it with one shortcut. New: Never Away keeps your computer awake and your status active, nudging the cursor 1 pixel only after a minute without use, and Auto Start reminds you if you left Zuturno off. Runs locally. Windows 10/11 and macOS 12+, 7-day free trial.

projects.title: PostPress
projects.summary: PostPress turns any X post, multi-part thread, or Article into a crisp 3× PNG card straight in your clipboard — 100% locally. 12 real materials, zero-crop 4-photo grids, 1-click privacy blur, zero servers or tracking (GPL-3.0).

projects.title: FoldLog
projects.summary: Turn iPhone Duo opens and closes into a daily timeline with two Shortcuts automations. Record locally for free, browse the latest 7 days, and unlock full history, statistics, widgets and CSV with optional one-time Pro. Requires iOS 27.1+. Unfolded time is not screen time.

projects.title: STT
projects.summary: STT (Speech to Text) is a free, open source dictation app for Mac. Press a keyboard shortcut, speak, press it again, and the text lands in the app in front. Runs offline with Whisper, Parakeet or Qwen. No history, no logs, no account.

projects.title: GlissTouch
projects.summary: A macOS menu bar app that adds custom trackpad gestures: rest a finger and tap another, multi finger taps and swipes, drawn shapes, one finger edge slides for volume and brightness, and two finger window snapping, each bound to one of 95+ actions, a sequence of them, or any keyboard shortcut.

projects.title: FileOctopus
projects.summary: Works like Finder: the same views, shortcuts, feel and Quick Look, so there is nothing to relearn. Built around three promises: fast, safe and stable. Adds split panes, and SFTP, WebDAV and S3-compatible storage in a pane. Free plan for everyday use, plus a 14-day trial of everything.

projects.title: 【工具自荐】叮当小宝CS：给中小卖家的 8 平台 AI 客服桌面客户端（免费每天 30 条）

github.name: 22109906/DingDangCS
github.description: 叮当小宝CS — 电商AI客服软件/智能客服机器人：淘宝千牛、京东京麦、拼多多、抖音飞鸽、快手小店、微信小店、闲鱼、小红书 8平台客服自动回复，多店铺管理+图片识别+人机协作转人工，免费版每日30条，Windows客户端

projects.summary: 我是叮当小宝CS 的作者，想自荐一个给中小电商卖家的 Windows AI 客服桌面客户端。 痛点很具体：小卖家往往一个人看好几个店，白天发货、晚上回消息，千牛、拼多多、京东来回切。市面上的机器人要么贵，要么必须企业资质走官方 ISV，要么有封号风险。我们的做法是做一个本地桌面助手： 支持千牛（淘宝/天猫）、拼多多、京东、抖店、快手、小红书、微信、闲鱼 8 个平台，装上即用 买家发图片能看懂：来图定制、商品细节、售后凭证，AI 直接看图应答，不会答非所问 可以设成「人工检查后发送」：AI 拟稿、人点发送，适合不放心的店主 知识库保存在本机，不上云 注册免费，每天 30 条 AI 接待额度 官网下载页：Windows 安装包约 35 MB GitHub 发布页：同一安装包，附 SHA256 需要说明的是项目不开源（免费使用、禁止逆向），源码私有，主要是想保护服务端实现。如果您觉得它更适合「谁在自荐」板块也没问题，欢迎试用并反馈。

projects.title: iVibe
projects.summary: iVibe is an open-source voice layer for your computer. Press one shortcut, show your screen and talk. Today it writes prompts with marked-up screenshots for your coding agent, and clean text in any app. Coming next: Vibes, modes you make yourself, and a note taker. Secrets are hidden on your device first.

projects.title: Wakeword
projects.summary: Key Highlights: • Instant Voice Switching: Say "code" to bring your editor to the front, or "notes" to start jotting ideas immediately. • Shortcuts Integration: Trigger macOS Shortcuts seamlessly with spoken commands. • Privacy First: All listening is processed directly on your Mac. • No Subscriptions: Free for up to 2 apps. Unlock unlimited apps with a single $10 lifetime payment. We’d love to hear your thoughts, feedback, and feature requests! 🔗 Try it here: https://wakeword.freecoop.net/

projects.title: Exee AI
projects.summary: Free desktop app for exam prep. Your notes stay on your computer; AI runs on your own ChatGPT plan.

projects.title: Freemoji
projects.summary: Emoji sites bury the copy button under ads and timers. Freemoji is just the search: type, tap, copied. All 3,972 emoji with skin tones, :shortcodes:, keyboard shortcuts, and a page per emoji with its meaning. No ads, no cookies, no tracking.

projects.title: Money Printer
projects.summary: Set your hourly rate or salary and a little printer in your menu bar counts what you earn, second by second. Track multiple jobs, overtime and breaks, fund savings goals, and get a receipt for every shift. Everything stays on your Mac.

projects.title: LanesMac
projects.summary: LanesMac puts every window in its own column on one long strip that scrolls past the edge of your screen. Open a new app and it slides in beside you. Nothing shrinks or overlaps. Stack related windows, turn a column into tabs, pin chat to the edge, or type to jump to any window. One strip per display, Control+Option shortcuts, a CLI and Raycast-ready links. Native, notarized, no SIP changes, no data collected. macOS 13+, Apple silicon and Intel.

projects.title: Steerglass
projects.summary: Steerglass is a free, open source Kubernetes desktop client for macOS, Windows and Linux, built for people who run many clusters. Put the same resource from several clusters in one live table, see every cluster's health at a glance, and get logs, shell, port-forward and YAML built in. Native Rust core, ~10 MB, no account, no telemetry. Optional AI help with your own model, even a local one: it reads, explains and suggests, and never changes anything without your OK.

projects.title: [开源推荐] simple_live_N：能订阅直播源、自动追帧的开源跨平台看直播客户端
projects.author: NishinoAkii

github.name: NishinoAkii/simple_live_N
github.description: Simple Live 修改版（基于 xiaoyaocz/dart_simple_live） / A modified version of Simple Live (based on xiaoyaocz/dart_simple_live)

projects.summary: simpleliveN 是 Simple Live 的修改版，用 Flutter 编写的看直播客户端，支持 Android、Android TV、iOS、Windows（含 Windows 7）和 macOS。在虎牙、斗鱼、哔哩哔哩、抖音之外新增了 Twitch、Kick、YouTube，还能通过 JavaScript 直播源订阅接入更多平台，适合想在一个 App 里看多个平台直播的人。 亮点 直播源订阅：一个脚本对应一个平台，添加订阅地址就能安装，脚本更新后不用重装 App。仓库附有编写指南和带注释的示例，可以自己接入新平台。 追帧加速：缓冲积压时略微加快播放，把画面追回到接近实时；遇到卡顿就恢复正常速度。 多设备同步：关注、观看记录、设置和直播源订阅可以通过 WebDAV 自动同步，也可以在局域网内的两台设备之间加密同步。 界面内置简体中文、繁体中文和英文，另可在 App 内下载日语、西班牙语翻译。 相比上游还加入了开播提醒、可搜索的聊天记录、按用户屏蔽和备注、Windows 多窗口和快捷键等功能。永久免费，GPL-3.0。 截图或演示视频

projects.title: AGASTHY
projects.summary: AGASTHY is a free, open-source desktop app that maps your developer machine: repos, runtimes, packages (Homebrew, npm, pip, cargo), AI tools and coding agents, linked in one graph. See what breaks before you remove something, track live Claude Code, Codex and Cursor sessions and their token cost, free disk space only from rebuildable folders, and give your agents a read-only MCP server. Local-first: no account, no telemetry. macOS first; Windows and Linux in preview.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】浮屿 Fuyu：Windows / macOS 屏幕顶部的灵动岛
projects.author: ShengLin1001

github.name: TixXin/Fuyu
github.description: 浮屿：Windows 和 macOS 上的轻量灵动岛。在屏幕顶部汇总 QQ、微信和邮件通知，查看 Claude Code / Codex 的运行状态并直接在岛上审批，还有剪贴板历史、快捷翻译、音乐与歌词、待办、日历和文件中转，支持插件扩展。

projects.summary: 浮屿在屏幕顶部放一座小岛，平时收成一条，鼠标移上去展开。岛上有待办、剪贴板历史、QQ / 微信 / 邮件提醒、快捷翻译、音乐和歌词。 写代码时我用得最多的是 Agent 页：Claude Code、Codex 等十来家 AI 编程工具的会话哪个在跑、哪个在等确认，都列在岛上，审批可以直接在岛上点。 岛上放什么由插件决定，收起条、展开页、设置页都能用插件加内容，内置功能也在改成插件，每个人都能 DIY 自己的岛。开源（AGPL-3.0），Tauri 写的，收起时内存 16 MB 左右。

projects.title: Local Dictation
projects.summary: Local Dictation turns your voice into text on your iPhone, iPad or Mac. The speech model is built into the app, so it works in airplane mode and nothing you say is uploaded. On iPhone and iPad a keyboard dictates into any app; on a Mac you hold a key and talk. More than 90 languages, clipboards for each topic, optional on-device translation on iPhone and iPad. No account, no ads, no tracking. Typing on the keyboard is free; dictation needs Pro.

projects.title: Netrix
projects.summary: Netrix brings SSH, Telnet, Serial and SFTP into a local-first Windows desktop app. Manage hosts, split terminals, transfer files, reuse snippets and view network maps. An encrypted workspace and credential vault keep saved data local. Free, MIT-licensed beta.

projects.title: RPGadget
projects.summary: RPGadget is a desktop toolkit for Game Masters on Windows. Bring in the rulebook you own for any RPG. RPGadget sorts your whole rulebook and makes it searchable. Nothing added, nothing removed. You are in full control. Build your world, its people and places, plan your campaign, and run the night from one desk. Your players join from their phones in any browser, at the table or across the country. Your books stay on your own PC. Try the free demo before you buy.

projects.title: Diskly
projects.summary: Diskly lives in your menu bar and warns you before your Mac runs out of space, naming exactly what's safe to clear. Open it to see where every gigabyte went, System Data included, explained in plain language. Delete with Undo.

projects.title: Pikori
projects.summary: A Mac menu bar app that shows what's left of your Claude Code and Codex 5-hour and weekly limits, with the exact reset times. It also keeps your recent copies and shows CPU, memory and battery. A pixel character gets tired as you run low.

projects.title: Dexibi
projects.summary: Meet Dexibi - an AI operator for your Windows desktop. Instead of switching between apps, menus, and prompts, tell Dexibi what you want to accomplish. It can interpret your instructions, use supported desktop tools, interact with applications, and help carry out multi-step workflows through voice. From everyday computer tasks to developer workflows, Dexibi is being built to turn natural instructions into real actions. Your voice. Your computer. The work gets done.

projects.title: USAddressGen
projects.summary: USAddressGen is a free random US address generator for testing — no signup required. Every address comes as an atomic city + state + ZIP triple, with 50 state-level filter pages, NANP reserved (555-01XX) phone numbers, and example.com reserved email addresses, so your test data never points at real people. Export to clipboard, save as a file, or download CSV/JSON. Built for form QA, database seeding, design demos, and localization testing — plus generators for HK, UK, JP and CA addresses.

projects.title: Sirio
projects.summary: Sirio is a native desktop app that runs Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi and Oh-My-Pi side by side, in terminals and chats for every git worktree, with a code editor, language servers and your pull requests beside them. Open source under the MIT licence, written in Rust on gpui.

projects.title: Pulso
projects.summary: Pulso is a Mac monitor for developers. Memory, swap and free disk in the menu bar; music, a Pomodoro timer and your Claude Code sessions in the notch; and a bottom bar that can replace the Dock. One-time payment, no account, under 1% CPU.

projects.title: Eyebrow
projects.summary: Eyebrow turns the notch into a live strip for music, volume, downloads, timers, meetings and Claude Code, and opens into a shelf, clipboard history and 18 widgets. Free on the Mac App Store; Pro is a one-time $4.99 with a 3-day trial.

projects.title: DarkCrate
projects.summary: DarkCrate is a desktop app for BlackBox contributors. It needs a BlackBox account and uploads only to BlackBox. It isn't a general stock footage tool. Editor: log-to-Rec.709 color for Sony, Canon, DJI and iPhone footage, looks, scopes, trim, crop, horizon leveling and stabilization. Metadata: built-in AI runs on your own computer and drafts each clip's title, description and keywords. Then it checks the clip and uploads it. No API keys, no subscription. Free for 10 clips, then $79 once.

projects.title: SandboxSim
projects.summary: SandboxSim starts an isolated macOS virtual machine from the macOS already on your Mac. No restore image to download, about 0.5 GB per new machine, Setup Assistant in about 20 seconds. Shared folders, clipboard and Touch ID.

projects.title: Trakisilo
projects.summary: Trakisilo combines your task board, clipboard manager, and time tracker into one desktop app that never touches the cloud. No account, no subscription, no network calls — your data stays on your machine. 2.0 ships a redesigned glass interface, a visual diagram canvas, math rendering, a smarter journal, and in-app viewers for Excel workbooks and Outlook mail attachments — openxlsx,xls,csv,eml, andmsg files right inside Trakisilo, no external app needed.

projects.title: Mesa
projects.summary: Mesa is a calm to-do list for iPhone and Mac. Three lists and nothing else: Today for what's due now, Upcoming for the week ahead, and Inbox for everything without a date. Reminders, repeats, place reminders, Siri and Shortcuts, and a one-tap import from Apple Reminders. No account, no setup, no tracking. Free to use, with Mesa Plus for iCloud sync, Apple Calendar, widgets and the Mac menu bar.

projects.title: Show HN: Lantern – desktop app that maps your repo and reviews AI-written PRs
projects.author: gitsad

projects.title: Kharchivo
projects.summary: Take control of your money without paying monthly subscription fees. Kharchivo makes personal expense tracking effortless with 1-tap iPhone & Android shortcuts, Excel/CSV bank statement imports, automatic duplicate detection, real-time spending analytics, recurring bill reminders, and calendar-based expense management. Everything you need to understand and manage your money, completely free. No subscriptions. No locked features.

projects.title: Confetti Magic
projects.summary: Celebrate any win with one shortcut: confetti, fireworks, snow or emoji rain across your whole Windows desktop, over every app and every monitor. Shipped a feature, closed a deal, finished a sprint, or made it to Friday? Press Alt+Shift+D. Share your screen on Teams, Zoom or Google Meet and everyone on the call sees it. Pause before you present; pick your colours and emoji sets. No account, no tracking. Free 7-day trial, then $4.99 once. A free Chrome extension does the same in your browser.

projects.title: Wherever
projects.summary: Wherever brings every file name on your disk into one live search. You can find a file by typing part of its name, narrow the results with filters, search the words inside your documents, and open a search panel from any app with one shortcut.

projects.title: Freehand Control
projects.summary: Control your Android device completely hands-free using your front camera. Perfect for cooking, studying flashcards, or browsing when your hands are busy or messy. 100% private, offline processing with custom gesture shortcuts and a smooth air-pointer.

projects.title: Sheenshot
projects.summary: Capture, beautify, and find any screenshot by its text. Hide desktop clutter with one shortcut, get backgrounds from the screenshot’s own colors, and paste size-right shots into AI chats. For Mac. Free, no account, no cloud.

projects.title: CharaBuddy
projects.summary: CharaBuddy is an AI desktop pet app for Windows, macOS and Linux. Install an interactive animated companion that chats by text or voice and lets you customize its look.

projects.title: Zen Timer
projects.summary: Zen Timer is a calm Pomodoro and focus timer for iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Mac, with a timer in the Mac menu bar. Every session you finish helps Orbilla, your focus companion, grow and rank up. It has the Garden, 12 languages and, with Zen Plus, Plan my day. No account. No ads. No tracking.

projects.title: PairOnce
projects.summary: PairOnce sends files and text between your phone and computer, browser to browser. No app, no account. Pair once with a code or QR. End-to-end encrypted, files up to 2 GB with resume, plus clipboard, scan to PDF and a command line for AI agents.

projects.title: Family Tree Design
projects.summary: Family Tree Design is a desktop app to map your family across generations. Build visual family trees, get AI BaZi analysis, hereditary risk alerts, blood type inheritance prediction, and smart name generation. All data stays local on your device — nothing is uploaded. Windows, macOS, and Linux, with a free trial.

projects.title: seshka
projects.summary: Claude Code sessions end. The dev servers, watchers and scripts they started don't. seshka shows them in your menu bar, grouped by session, with memory and ports. Kill them in one click. End idle sessions too, by hand or automatically. Free and open source.

projects.title: Show HN: Clview – a universal doc viewer for the terminal
projects.author: ferd
projects.summary: I hate leaving the terminal, so clv was born: it shows images, Markdown, PDFs, Word documents, spreadsheets, SVGs, and HTML right in your kitty-compatible terminal. Supports light/dark modes, search, copy to clipboard, follow links (ala Vimium), browsing directories/zips/tars, open your default app. I hope others find it useful. I'd appreciate your feedback! --- Short boring history: clv began as the `view` subcommand I proposed for pdfcraft's cli (PR #2920). I immediately realized I wanted to support other types of docs. Prior to clv I was using icat for images, tdf for PDFs, mdv or mdcat for Markdown, and didn't have a solution for most other doc types. So I imagined a "display anything" command, and here we are.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】Tomoru：实时双语字幕与截屏翻译桌面应用，支持本地离线运行（macOS / Windows）
projects.author: ACAne0320

github.name: ACAne0320/Tomoru
github.description: Live bilingual subtitles for anything your computer plays: videos, streams, games and meetings. On your computer or in the cloud.

projects.summary: 一个开源的桌面应用，捕获电脑或指定应用播放的声音，实时识别并在屏幕上显示双语悬浮字幕，同时支持快捷键框选屏幕翻译文字。适用于看外语直播、生肉番剧、打游戏或开外语会议。 主要特点： 支持全部系统声音或单个应用：可以只听浏览器里的直播，不影响正在玩的游戏；字幕窗支持穿透点击、跨屏拖动，并可在录屏中隐藏。 支持完全本地离线运行：语音识别（Apple 原生识别、SenseVoice、Qwen3-ASR）和翻译（Index-Translate、Hy-MT2）均可下载模型在本机离线运行，也可选择云端或接入自己的 API。 边说边译：不用等对方整句说完，前半句先给出大意，说完再补全整句翻译，看直播不卡顿。 场景与专名对照表：针对常看的番剧、主播或游戏建立词表，既能统一译名，也会把语音识别听错的近音原文一并改对。 免 OCR 截屏翻译：遇到没配音的游戏对话框、视频看板或直播弹幕，按快捷键框选屏幕即可直接多模态翻译。 使用 Go + MyGo 构建，GPL-3.0 开源，提供 macOS 和 Windows 版本（Linux 版本即将推出）。

projects.title: VimPDF：像用 Vim 一样读 PDF
projects.author: rpish

github.name: zhpencil/VimPDF
github.description: Vim-style PDF reader with highlights, notes, flashcards and math support. Electron + React for macOS, Windows and Linux.

projects.summary: 多年前初学 Linux 时，为了退出 vi 被迫学了 Vim 快捷键。 后来发现了 Vimium 这款用键盘刷网页的神器，从此一发不可收拾，想方设法不让双手离开键盘。 最近正好要看些 PDF 文档，于是 Vibe Coding 了这个让大家双手不离键盘，便捷阅读批注的阅读器。 ![hero](https://github.com/zhpencil/VimPDF/raw/main/docs/hero.png) 功能比较简单，不过难免有些小 bug，欢迎大家使用反馈，给我发 pr，或者 fork 二次开发。 Github 地址：https://github.com/zhpencil/VimPDF

projects.title: [WeClipper] Windows 剪贴板助手更新到 v0.8.8：搜索、纯文本粘贴、Win+V
projects.author: xmagicer
projects.summary: 上次在 V 站发 WeClipper 还是 v0.4.5，来补个更新帖。 之前评论里有人说，没有搜索就不会换，也有人问能不能用 Win+V 唤出。现在这两个都有了 hh 还是个 Windows 剪贴板小工具，按快捷键唤出列表，选中后直接粘贴。免费，不用注册，剪贴板内容保存在本机。 官网：[https://weclipper.xmagicer.com/](https://weclipper.xmagicer.com/) 下载：[Windows 安装版](https://weclipper.xmagicer.com/#/download)（Windows 10 及以上） 相比[上一帖](https://www.v2ex.com/t/1112466)，主要多了这些： - **搜索和键盘操作。** 面板打开后按 Ctrl+F 搜索，↑↓ 选中、Enter 粘贴；当前列表前 9 条可以用 Ctrl+1～9 直接粘贴。不用搜索的时候，输入框就收起来。 - **纯文本粘贴。** 选中条目后按 Shift+Enter，或者从右键菜单里选。快捷键可以自己改。也修了从表格复制后，纯文本粘贴为空的问题。 - **固定面板。** 固定后粘贴一次不会关掉，可以接着选下一条。常用条目也可以固定在列表前面。 - **图文预览。** 同时带图片和文字的条目会显示“图片＋文字”，可以分别预览图片和原文。按住 Alt 临时预览，松开收起；按右方向键也能展开预览。 - **Win+V 唤出。** 设置里可以开启替代系统剪贴板，也可以继续用自己的快捷键。唤出、搜索和纯文本粘贴的按键都可以在设置里改。 界面也重新整理了一遍，分类和搜索放在同一行，固定、删除放进了右键菜单，列表清爽一点。 新版的样子： ![WeClipper 面板](https://weclipper.xmagicer.com/shots/zh/panel-light.png?v=1bb79ecbac62) ![图片和文字分别预览](https://weclipper.xmagicer.com/shots/zh/mixed-light.png?v=1bb79ecbac62) 之前用过的可以再试试，有什么用着不顺手的地方，欢迎留言。

projects.title: 做了一个 iOS 离线音乐播放器 离音： Wi-Fi 拖歌、APE/FLAC/DSD、10 段均衡器更新啦，发帖送一波永久 pro 送码

projects.summary: 一个纯本地音乐播放器（iPhone / iPad / Apple 芯片 Mac），无账号、无广告、不上传音频。1.7.3 共 19 处改动，补的是几件一直欠着的事：能播的格式少一块、桌面上没得用、从服务器拿歌得先存到「文件」。 格式：MP3 / M4A / MP4 / AAC / FLAC / ALAC / WAV / AIFF·AIF / CAF / MP1·MP2 / OGG·OGA / Opus / DSF·DFF / APE；APE 与 FLAC 内嵌 CUE 也认，旁边放 .lrc 就是逐行歌词。另有 10 段参数均衡器与 ReplayGain。 ![](https://i.imgur.com/bkiQd0O.png) ## 1.7.3 更新 1. APE 现在能直接播（Pro）。不是导入时先转一道 WAV，是边读边解码：后台线程按块取 PCM 进环形缓冲，均衡器和播放器照常取数据，全程没有中间文件。为什么不做缓存转码——APE 无损，一首五分钟解成 WAV 就是 50–100MB，一张专辑几百兆，首次播放还得等转完；实测解码速度是实时的 20–100 倍，余量足够，没必要拿磁盘换时间。代价是只做立体声：多声道的 APE（DVD-A 抓的那种）直接拒绝播放，不静默下混。 2. 整轨 + .cue 的专辑按曲目分开。APE 与 FLAC 内嵌的 CUE 也认，不用在文件旁边再放一份。 3. Mac 上原生运行。不另做一套 Mac 界面，同一份工程跑在 Apple 芯片的 Mac 上，曲库、播放器、Wi-Fi 传歌、导入全是 iPad 那一套；长页面可以按住鼠标拖动滚动，和系统里其它应用一致。取舍：需要 Apple 芯片的 Mac，Intel 机器不在范围内。 4. WebDAV 导入。浏览服务器目录，挑文件或整个文件夹，落到本地和「文件」导入走同一条管线——命名、去重、元数据、CUE 展开都一致，不会出现「服务器来的歌和本地的不一样」。服务器密码进钥匙串，不写明文配置。取舍：单向的「挑一次、落到本地」，不做双向同步，也不扫你服务器上的整个曲库。 5. 睡眠定时独立成页（Pro）：圆环选时长，1 分钟到 14 小时，结束前淡出；倒计时可以暂停，想多听两首按一下，不用重设。 6. iPad / Mac 键盘快捷键：空格播放暂停，⌘← ⌘→ 切歌，⇧⌘← ⇧⌘→ 快进快退，⌘R 切循环、⌘S 切随机；设置里新增一页列全。 7. 其余几处：音频或整个文件夹拖到文件夹页即导入；长按一首歌直接改标题、歌手、专辑、封面；歌单、收藏和自定义标题导出成带版本号的文件，换设备导回去；「存储」页拆开显示音频、封面、歌词、数据和缓存各占多少；关联文件夹保留目录结构，新文件不用手动重扫；文件在 App 外被改名或移动后，歌单按路径 → 文件名 → 标题与歌手三步找回；搜索更快，大小写和变音符号都不敏感；歌单页加了「最近播放」。 8. 修了几处老毛病。最要紧的是换 Apple 账号后 Pro 不再消失：只有商店明确告知「已撤销」才锁回免费，账号切换、离线、商店没回应都保留上一次判定——宁可晚锁一个退款的，也不误锁一个付过钱的。另外修了：中日韩标签的曲名不再变问号；同时带新旧标题标签的歌显示正确标题；横屏在歌词处下滑能收起播放器；系统关掉实时活动时，锁屏歌词页会说明原因并给出开关入口。 免费下载；Pro 一次性买断，不订阅。DSD 与 APE 播放、保存自己的 EQ 调音、播放倍速、睡眠定时、全部主题与播放器样式、备用图标与自定义封面、三行锁屏歌词在 Pro 里，其余都能免费用。 ## 送 10 个码 ``` 8EKFE6TETNPAFN6TKH TPH66L6FMHRTM773XF 4L4W4XL3F7XWTTWETA MAPF4Y3TR3FP4K7FPL 86ET78FWRRXARMNXKP MKYRXKJMHWLTKX7JPF HHRHENAW7834HTRR7M AMEHKARATPTWXA8XNJ WMPER7TRL7XN6AKPT8 L37NTNEFJFK7EWEPR7 ``` 有问题大家可以进群反馈 ![](https://i.imgur.com/vcwUVqA.png)

projects.author: manukminasyan
projects.summary: I asked rela (the assistant inside my open source crm relaticle) once for a task and a note (in a test workspace). It shows me a plan, one line per change, one approve button. There was no task or note until I clicked approve. Relaticle (my open source CRM) has an MCP server for AI agents right in the core app. Claude and ChatGPT connect to it, and over the MCP protocol, they don't need a plan, they don't need an approve button, the writes just land right away. projects.title: 【开源自荐】dayan-enterprise-ai-skills：一人公司实战沉淀的 66 枚中文企业级 Agent Skills（去 AI 腔 / 标书打分闭环 / 合同四审 / 兜错知识库）
projects.author: Kosmoray

github.name: Kosmoray/dayan-enterprise-ai-skills
github.description: 成都大衍千机科技有限公司（雷可扬）开源：66枚企业AI实战技能库与10大WorkBuddy专家团 (MIT License) | dayanqianji.com

projects.summary: 阮老师好，自荐一个我们在真实企业交付中沉淀并开源（MIT 协议）的中文 Agent 技能库：dayan-enterprise-ai-skills。 它是什么：一套兼容 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex CLI 与腾讯 WorkBuddy 的 SKILL.md 实战技能包（共 66 枚），聚焦中文商业成稿、招投标与合同风控、企业知识库架构以及实体行业算账诊断。 为什么要做这个库： 我在成都创立了一家做企业 AI 落地的“一人公司（OPC）”。过去一年给工厂、外贸、连锁和服务型企业做方案与内训时，最深的体会是：裸调大模型做个人玩具很惊艳，但一进真实商业场景就会撞上三堵墙： 1. 中文机器腔太重：写出来的汇报和方案满篇“赋能、抓手、闭环、排比三连”，没法直接发给客户和老板； 2. 自审同温层：同一个会话刚写完代码、合同或标书，顺手让它检查，90% 只会轻飘飘回一句没问题，漏掉无限连带赔偿或 ★ 号废标项； 3. 重概念轻呈现：吐出几千字纯文本没人看，用 Mermaid 画复杂中文架构图经常挤字压线。 所以我们把内部每天高频在用的 66 套作业规范脱敏拆了出来，核心不在“提示词话术”，而在几条写死在技能里的工程约束： 生成者与只读审查官分离：例如 dayan-bid-scoring-loop（投标技术方案）强制拆成写手与只读模拟评委逐项打分找扣分点；dayan-contract-4way-audit 从交付、财务、法务、销售四个视角并行挑刺并给出可直接替换的条款文本；dayan-code-adversary 在只读状态下用破坏者、半年后新人、安全戍边三副反方眼镜审代码变更。 中文去 AI 腔五类病灶库（dayan-humanize-pro）：专门针对中文语境清理空洞拔高词、工整四字三连、架空动词与破折号滥用，强制走“草稿 → 换脑挑残留破绽 → 净稿”三段式改写。 零外部依赖单文件交付（dayan-business-html / dayan-svg-diagram）：内置一套 #1B365D 深蓝印刷感单文件 HTML 高管看板母版（等宽数字、防孤字换行表格）与手算坐标 SVG 架构图规范，发进微信或飞书点开即读。 兜错优先的企业知识库蓝图（dayan-rag-guardrail-kb）：按“权限预过滤 → 责任人签字定权威版 → 价格/制度超期熔断 → 原文模糊接地四态兜错”设计，宁可诚实留白不瞎编报价。 实体经营算账工具：包含 13 周滚动现金流断流压测、应收款分级催收、采购核价拆解，以及制造 8D 客诉报告、工程签证防核减、餐饮单店真实毛利核算等垂直场景。 已知边界说明： SKILL.md 本质是给智能体注入结构化作业契约、反例红线与交付母版，能解决单次任务的方法论与排版纪律；但涉及真实招投标资质原件核验、正式法律签署、跨系统幂等写入等高风险生产环节，技能内均强制标注了人工复核停手点，不能替代确定性后端代码与人工终审。 快速体验： bash 使用 skills CLI 按需或全量安装（自动适配 Claude Code / Cursor / Codex） npx -y skills add Kosmoray/dayan-enterprise-ai-skills 或克隆仓库执行本地安装脚本 git clone cd dayan-enterprise-ai-skills && bash install.sh GitHub 在线关键词检索页： 官网介绍与案例： 我是项目作者雷可扬，欢迎各位同行和朋友试用挑刺！

projects.title: Show HN: Prediction market competition where only agents can trade
projects.author: TNNick
projects.summary: Hi HN. I’ve been working on a project called Vaticin (with an i). Interested in your feedback. Vaticin is a prediction market competition platform where only agents are allowed to make wagers. Humans can’t directly do so themselves. There’s no real-money wagering involved. Vaticin is built for competition, research, and education. Every Monday morning, our LLM generates about 300 yes/no prediction questions across six categories: sports, finance, tech, entertainment, geopolitics, and science. The competition window runs Monday through Saturday, although some predictions won’t resolve for several weeks later. Agents take positions/allocations throughout the week, and then wagering locks on Saturday. Odds are live/dynamic and update with every new wager. Then a new competition cycle starts the next Monday. We have a live leaderboard that refreshes as our LLM resolves prediction questions each night (with human moderation of resolutions). Recognizing the value of existing prediction market competition platforms, we wanted to focus on forecasting models that are not only well-calibrated, but also make good market decisions and integrate game theory into their strategy. On Vaticin, agents have to decide which markets to take positions on, when to take a position, and how much to allocate. With the dynamic odds, agents have to adapt throughout the competition cycle. Vaticin measures more than raw prediction accuracy. We built a few ways to build an agent. Beginners can use our no-code “agent builder” and choose which forecasting parameters/strategies they want to use, then Vaticin codes their agent, shows the user the code, but allows them to edit the code. I hope it will help beginners learn more about coding and AI agents. More experienced builders can connect their own agents through an API. We added private tournaments, where users can create their own tournaments with their own prediction questions and fantasy tournaments where “captains” can recruit a team of agents from other users. Separate leaderboards. We’re still building, and recognize the site isn’t “perfect” yet, but the weekly competitions/private tournaments/fantasy tournaments are live. I’d really appreciate feedback on a few things: - Is Vaticin’s market-based/gamified format different enough from existing forecasting competitions to be relevant? - How would you score and rank agents over the long term? We use metrics like Brier score vs the market with adjustments for wager sample size. What else should we consider? - What features would make you interested in entering an agent into the competition? - Would private/custom tournaments be useful for classes, research groups, hackathons, or recruiting? - How should we discourage human users from hand-picking their “autonomous” agents’ bets? For Vaticin-hosted agents we can log every code edit, but we aren’t sure how to integrate that into the agent ratings. For self-hosted agents we can’t track this at all. Any insight into how other bot leagues (poker, algo trading, etc) handle this? Leaderboard: https://www.vaticin.ai/leaderboard Note: Early in the competition week, the leaderboard will show many agents at or close to their starting 100,000-token balance because a lot of positions haven't been resolved yet (and tokens are deducted when a wager is made, so the leaderboard will show many agents with less than their initial 100,000 token allocation). Markets: https://www.vaticin.ai/markets Note: The prediction questions are only visible when the weekly competition cycle is open, so if you visit on the weekend that page may be empty. You can pull up prior weeks’ predictions to take a look. Agent builder: https://www.vaticin.ai/build-an-agent Everything is free right now. No ads. Happy to answer questions. Thanks for any feedback, good or bad. Thanks!

projects.title: Show HN: Nunya – A "digital privacy screen" that makes text illegible from afar
projects.author: magicmarc
projects.summary: Hello! I'm Marc. I've built "Nunya", which is a sort of "digital privacy screen". It redraws text to make it readable when looking at your monitor or phone from a normal distance, while making it hard to read by someone who might be looking over your shoulder. It's based on “hybrid images” like the famous Einstein/Monroe image (from the paper at https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/1141911.1141919 ) and I thought it'd make a great way to mask text on your phone that you don't want someone nearby reading. I particularly spent time on the transition - I wanted the text to be incredibly legible when close, but incredibly illegible when being far, and tried to optimise for a minimal transition between the two. Demos can be seen at my site for it here: https://usenunya.com I first released this over ten years ago as "PrivacyMessage" (my app names have definitely improved) when Apple first allowed iMessage apps. This was my first app geared towards the general market as I've spent the last 13 years developing iOS apps for a fairly niche market. I'm happy to have brought it back as “Nunya”, and have currently made it available in three forms: - Nunya for Messages (iPhone) I first remade my iMessage app and gave it a bit more polish. It's free for 5 sends, and then $4.99 for a permanent unlock. - Potfolio (iPhone) I then figured Nunya would make for a great flagship feature in a "wealth tracking" finance app I was already working on, so anyone who might glance at your phone when on public transport can't quite see your bank balances. It's currently free (though I might add some new features with IAPs to it later). - Nunya for Chrome A friend then suggested it'd make for a great Chrome extension to be used on all sites. It's free to hide money amounts, and £10 (around $13) to unlock it to work with more (bank details, bitcoin addresses, etc). You can try it here: https://usenunya.com/chrome This is my first real attempt at making apps for a wider market. It's also my very first Chrome extension, and I'm not entirely sure how best to price each of these, nor how to best gate their features. I don't particularly like subscriptions if I can avoid them. I'm curious to hear any thoughts. Particularly: do you think these pricing models are reasonable? I also wonder if Nunya would make for a good feature elsewhere. With more staff working remotely who might be in transit or in cafes, I can imagine businesses could be keen for their staff to use it on more sensitive data. Does that seem plausible? Thanks all.

projects.author: MichalKrk
projects.summary: GTA 6 is here! I used to work in marketing automation, which mostly meant clicking around Klaviyo all day. So I built the obvious thing: an agent that does the clicking while I'm in Vice City. It runs in my Chrome through an extension (using Playwright), using the tools I am already logged into. It can build a welcome flow in Klaviyo click by click, the way I would at work. My favorite feature I added thus far? You can tell it to slow down and click more slowly :D Finishing a week of work by 10am is how you get caught. The serious part is how good models have become at using a browser. A few months ago I posted my Google Ads MCP here ( https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49548962 ). I spent the summer building 65 tools for one platform. Now an agent just uses the same UI I use, on almost any site. Great use of my summer :D It's slower than an API, but it doesn't need anyone to build the API first (and slow is a feature, see above). The plan has only one flaw: GTA 6 has no PC version, so the agent can't play it for me. Humans keep that one job. I think this could be a real business, but I haven't figured out exactly how. I made pages for the obvious use cases and started running Google Ads to see what people care about (although I might stop them soon as the prices are crazy, 10 USD per click is nuts): https://shoppilot.ch/email-marketing/ https://shoppilot.ch/google-ads/ https://shoppilot.ch/seo/ Happy to hear your thoughts on this :DD If I reply slowly, I'm playing GTA. projects.summary: 大家好，我是 Trina AX 的作者，来自韩国，想自荐这个 AGPL-3.0 开源项目。我在韩国帮一些小公司部署 Claude Code，常见的情况是老板第一天就用得很顺手，给全员都开了账号，但大部分员工很少打开。我猜原因是员工的 Claude 对公司一无所知，从一个空文件夹开始。老板自己的 Claude 好用，是因为他花了几周把写方案、报价、报告的做法写成了 Skill 和 CLAUDE.md，而这些只存在他的电脑里。 Trina AX 在一台服务器上跑 Claude Code 和 Codex，团队有一个共用的文件夹：全公司、部门、项目、团队 Skill、个人文件夹。每个人的 AI 都从这里开始，按同一份 SKILL.md 做事。AI 每打开一个文件，服务器都会按提问者本人的权限检查一次，比如 Finance 文件夹某个人打不开，他的 AI 也打不开。 有网页、Mac、Windows、iPhone、Android 客户端，员工不用碰终端，界面支持简体中文。 能读韩国政府常用的 HWP/HWPX 文档，也能预览 PDF 和 PowerPoint。 自托管免费，不限人数，需要 Debian 12/13 或 Ubuntu 24.04（4 GB 内存），也可以用 Docker（比 Linux 安装新，测试得少）。 有 10 分钟的本地演示（虚构团队，不接 AI）： 需要先说清楚：自托管不等于离线，AI 回答所需的内容会发给你接入的 Claude 或 OpenAI。服务器运维人员能读到存储的文件和聊天记录，没有安全认证。关于中国大陆，不提供任何中转或绕过访问限制的办法，接入的账号需要在你所在的地区能正常使用。 中文说明： 欢迎试用和反馈，谢谢！

Agent 就是业务前端：没有日常业务录入页面，员工直接用自己惯用的 Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw、Hermes 或任意 MCP 客户端，用自然语言完成报工时、贴发票报销、拟报价单、核对采购三单匹配、预留库存并过账发货；React Console 仅保留给管理员做团队配置、权限管控和审计回看。 2. 业务规则是带版本的自然语言，而不是 if/else：审批流、折扣红线、数据校验规范以纯文本形式存储在版本化、带生效日期的 businessrules 表中，流程位置由只追加的 approvalrecords 与 todos 实时推导——调整审批路线只需对管理员 Agent 说一句话，无需改代码或重新发布。 3. 零 SDK 的 SKILL.md + HTTP（并原生内置 OAuth 2.1 POST /mcp）：员工本地 Agent 通过浏览器 Device Flow（oryh-connect）授权一次，即可自动拉取与其 RBAC 角色严格匹配的 Markdown 技能包和 OpenAPI 契约；服务端通过 PostgreSQL Row-Level Security（RLS）、不可篡改明细账本及账期锁定兜底，确保 Agent 无论怎么理解上下文都无法越权写坏账。 单租户完整功能开箱自托管（docker compose up -d --build，支持可选执行 scripts/seedsample.py 一键加载虚构公司样例数据进行体验）。欢迎大家体验和指正！

projects.title: Show HN: Darkroomfinder.org – A Directory of Photography Darkrooms
projects.author: stokesj84
projects.summary: I built darkroomfinder.org, a directory of photography darkrooms, as a React single page app (SPA), because I wanted to understand how SPAs work and I wanted to scale to hundreds or thousands of cities without managing routes and pages for each of them. The site currently lists over 350 darkrooms across over 50 countries. However in deciding to build a SPA I failed to realize the downsides of SPAs for SEO. As an SPA darkroomfinder.org only has one route, i.e. darkroomfinder.org. Therefore GoogleBot only indexes the root domain and if someone searches for "Darkrooms" the site might surface in Google Search, but if a user searches "San Francisco Darkrooms" Google Search is much less likely to return darkroomfinder.org as nothing indicates the site has information about San Francisco. Solving this SEO problem while maintaining the simplicity of the SPA turned out to be a challenge but I think I have arrived at a solution that checks most of the desired boxes at the cost of being tied more closely to Cloudflare's infrastructure. Cloudflare, the DNS and CDN for darkroomfinder.org, has a serverless primitive, Cloudflare Workers. These Cloudflare Workers are distributed at the edge, have KV caches, and can intercept specific paths. So my solution to having both an SPA and indexable city routes is to have Cloudflare Workers cache the city data and intercept city routes directed at darkroomfinder.org returning an HTML page with the city data and the full React SPA which boots over the HTML page. So technically it's one SPA served to many routes. GoogleBot in traversing one of these city routes, like darkroomfinder.org/san-francisco, will index the HTML page while humans using browsers receive the same HTML which the React SPA boots over. Part of the project that remains unsolved is data collection and validation. Darkroom discovery is automated by agents running daily scans for unlisted darkrooms. But a human still has to validate that the discovered darkrooms exist and try to determine what capabilities they have such as B&W or color developing etc. I am currently working on an automated reachability and vitality checker to determine if the darkrooms already in the directory are still active, since photography darkrooms sometimes cease operations long before taking down their websites or social feeds. darkroomfinder.org

projects.summary: 做了一个记录飞行的网站。把航旅纵横的截图、电子行程单（PDF、OFD）或者 Flighty、Flightradar24、OpenFlights 的导出拖进去，它会认出每一班航班，按你在哪里过夜判断哪几段算同一次出门，再画到一个地球上。不用注册就能试：第一次上传后地图就画好了，想留下再注册，不注册 7 天后删除。 地球用的是 NASA 的 Blue Marble 和夜间灯光图，太阳在它真实的位置。每班航班都沿航线算出途中的昼夜，在天上的每一小时按当时窗外的天色上色；还没飞的航班，会提前告诉你日出在哪一侧窗外。一年、一次旅程或者一班航班，都能存成一张 3:4 的分享卡片。 每个账户只看得到自己的航班。公开主页默认关闭，打开后航班也要落地三天才出现。界面有简体、繁体和英文。 可以自托管，一个 Docker 镜像（amd64 和 arm64）加一个 SQLite 数据库。读截图和 PDF 需要 Anthropic API 密钥，其他格式不用。React 19 + MapLibre GL，代码 MIT 协议。大部分代码由 Claude Code 写成，我定方向、逐屏把关。

projects.author: vmikhailov
projects.summary: We all use different agentic systems, bots, chats, and so on. One day I realized that I need to copy context between the apps. It is annoying. So I created a trivial local MCP which sits on top of SQLite and exposes Cypher so LLM can query anything. Also LLM can define a schema if it understands it needs new nodes or edges. How do I use it: 1. I've scanned all my documents and stored passports, driver licences and all kind of contracts for my apartment, insurance and so on. And not only mine - the entire family. 2. I've extracted all the key date and values. Also gemini extracted all the personal relations. Like "Alex is-a-child-of Bob". "Bob is-married-to Anna". So i can ask "give me a passport number of my son" and it gives it back instantly. It might not be a big deal, but it is very convenient. 3. It stores all the projects I'm working on, key steps and decisions. 4. And the most important thing - it works from anywhere. I can ask Hermes i telegram to remind me when my insurance ends or I can reference my project in ClaudeCode just by name and it will get the entire history from Antigravity. I would be happy if you guys find it useful.

projects.title: Show HN: A playable world model of the Backrooms
projects.author: yelarys
projects.summary: A 211M-param transformer acts as a game engine. It draws every next frame from the last 2.4 seconds and my inputs. projects.title: 我用 GFS 建站引擎做了一个 Krillion 专题游戏
projects.author: Errat1c
projects.summary: 最近关注独立开发和出海建站，发现两个挺有意思的热点： 一个是 **Krillion 游戏突然爆火**，另一个是 **哥飞的建站引擎也越来越火**。 Krillion 的玩法很有意思，不是考你能不能答对，而是考你能不能想到别人想不到的答案。 比如给你一个开放式问题，大家都能回答，但越常见的答案得分越低，越冷门且符合要求的答案反而得分越高。 这种反直觉的玩法挺容易让人上头，也特别适合朋友之间互相比较成绩。 看到 Krillion 的热度后，我就想：既然游戏这么火，哥飞的建站引擎又能快速搭建网站，能不能把两者结合起来，自己做一个小游戏网站？ 于是就有了 **DailyGame.gg**。 网站地址：https://dailygame.gg/ ### 目前上线了两个游戏版本 **1. Krillion Lite（自己开发的原创版本）** 参考 Krillion 的冷门答案玩法，自己做了一个轻量版，每天提供一组挑战题目。 核心思路是： - 不只是回答正确，还要尽量避免大众化答案 - 鼓励玩家发散思维，寻找更独特的回答 - 每天一道挑战流程，适合利用碎片时间玩一会儿 - 浏览器直接打开就能玩，不需要下载安装 希望保留 Krillion 最有趣的部分，同时让游戏体验更轻量。 **2. Krillion Unlimited（嵌入的游戏版本）** 除了自己开发的 Lite 版本，网站还嵌入了 PlayDaily.org 提供的 Krillion Unlimited 游戏。 这个版本没有每天只能玩一次的限制，一局包含 7 道题，每道题限时 25 秒。 如果觉得每天一局不过瘾，可以一直挑战，看看自己能想出多少冷门答案。 这里也说明一下：Unlimited 不是我开发的，网站只是提供了嵌入式游玩入口；Lite 才是自己开发的版本。 ### 关于哥飞的建站引擎 这次也算是一次快速建站实践。 以前做一个小游戏网站，从页面设计、游戏开发到上线部署，往往需要花不少时间。 这次借助哥飞的建站引擎搭建网站，再结合自己的游戏开发，整个从想法到上线的过程轻量了不少。 对独立开发者来说，我觉得这类工具最大的价值不是单纯省去写代码的时间，而是能够更快验证一个想法。 看到一个有意思的玩法，可以先做出能玩的版本，再根据玩家反馈继续完善。 ### 后续准备继续做什么？ 目前网站刚上线，功能还比较简单。 接下来打算用建站引擎完善自己的 Krillion Lite 版本，同时也考虑加入更多适合浏览器直接玩的轻量小游戏。 网站：https://dailygame.gg/ 欢迎 V 友体验，尤其想听听大家对原创 Lite 版本的意见： 1. 冷门答案这种玩法有没有意思？ 2. Lite 版本还有哪些值得增加的功能？ 3. 如果做成一个每日小游戏合集，大家会愿意经常回来玩吗？ 第一次尝试用这种方式快速上线小游戏网站，欢迎交流，也欢迎拍砖 : )

projects.title: Show HN: Quadrivia – Trivia for the Intellectually Curious
projects.author: jchaykow
projects.summary: I made Quadrivia, a trivia game covering science, math, logic, nature, geography, and philosophy. I had the idea about ten years ago. I like trivia, but I don't know much about pop culture, so I wanted a game built for subjects I enjoy. I started writing down questions in my phone's Notes app and reading them to my friends. That eventually became this app. I put a ton of care into the question creation. The questions are the game. Some reward knowing something interesting, whilst others give you a foothold to reason toward the answer. Building that balance is the hardest part, but when you see the a-ha moment on players faces you begin to understand why the question design is so important. The game can be played solo but is meant to be played with friends around a table or over FaceTime. You earn "citations" across fields of knowledge and the first to an h-index of 4 wins the game. The app is free to download with a started question set that supports complete games. If you're interested in the name: Trivia comes from "Trivium" which in Medieval education were the three foundational subjects (Grammar, Logic, and Rhetoric). Similarly, Quadrivia comes from "Quadrivium" which in Roman times referred to the four mathematical disciplines (Arithmetic, Music, Geometry, and Astronomy).

github.description: Your GitHub, a different way. 无需部署的复古个人主页 & Gist 博客。

projects.summary: ClassyGit 不是又一个静态博客生成器。它不托管内容，也不要求你把文章搬过来：它把你已经在 GitHub 上的公开数据（个人主页 README、仓库、Gist、Gist 评论）直接渲染成你的复古个人主页和博客。 四种复古主题：System 6 / Win98 / TUI / NES 不搬文章、不换编辑器，Gist 写完就算文章发布 没有数据库、没有后台、没有账号体系，只有 GitHub 里的文件 你的内容不在 ClassyGit 的数据库里，它一直在你的 GitHub 上。ClassyGit 只是一层可以替换的皮肤。即使公共实例哪天停止，README、仓库、Gist 和留言仍然在 GitHub，换一个实例或自建就能继续 为什么是 ClassyGit 不用部署：Fork 仓库，改一个 classy.config.json 实现自定义配置，最多 5 分钟生效。没有 build、CI、发布按钮。 不用登录：访客打开链接就能看；站主也不用注册，配置就是 GitHub 上的一个文件。 不用服务器：内容在 GitHub，页面由 Cloudflare 边缘渲染。没有 VPS、数据库、对象存储要维护。

projects.title: [开源推荐] Crisis Rehearsal：事前 72 小时声誉危机预演 CLI（纯 Python 标准库零 API Key 离线可复现）
projects.author: yepinggu66

github.name: yepinggu66/crisis-rehearsal
github.description: Rehearse a reputational crisis 72h before it breaks: swarm simulation + 30-event public backtest, offline CLI, HTML dossiers, enterprise/government docs. AGPL-3.0.

projects.summary: Crisis Rehearsal（微鱼危机预演，AGPL-3.0）是一个在声誉危机爆发前 72 小时进行多智能体沙盘预演的开源 Python CLI 工具，附带 30 个真实历史事件的 T-72h 公开回测与 SHA-256 证据复现包，纯标准库零 API Key 即可离线复现。 亮点 零 API Key、纯 Python 标准库、完全离线 30 秒复现：安装后仅需两行命令（pipx install git+ && crh demo --out demo），无需联网、无需配置大模型 Key，即可自动校验 data/evidence.sha256、重算 30 事件 × 3 轮回测统计（82.2%，95% CI 78.5–85.9），并生成 4 份自包含的 HTML 危机预演档案报告。 严谨坦诚的工程方法论：将历史危机倒带回爆发前 72 小时（严格隔离事后信息）验证识别 Top-3 风险的方向性价值，并坦诚公开未达标稳定性指标（STA 58 < 60）与待人工校准项。 完整工具链：支持 crh verify 证据校验、crh pack init/validate 自定义危机剧本、crh site 生成静态证据站。

projects.summary: 我是 Music Lyrics Bar 的作者。用 Mac 看书时，想看清刚唱过去的那句词，又不想来回切窗口，就写了这个菜单栏小工具。在 Apple Music 里播放一首歌，点开一次歌词面板，再切回书页。抬头看菜单栏，就能看到正唱到哪一句。 亮点 直接读「音乐」已经缓存在本机的歌词，不用申请 API 密钥。缓存里带有词或音节的时间戳时，唱过的部分会逐渐亮起来；只有行时间戳时就逐行显示。 实现思路可以看 Swift 用 Apple Events 读取当前播放进度，再从本地缓存里按「歌名 + 歌手 + 时长」匹配同一录音。缓存是苹果的私有格式，系统更新后可能失效；匹配不上时不会去别处补词。 v0.0.6 提供通用版 ZIP，内含 Apple Silicon 和 Intel 两种架构，适用于 macOS 13 及以上版本。应用采用临时签名，未经苹果公证。首次打开时系统会提示无法验证开发者，关闭提示后到「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性」为 Music Lyrics Bar 选择「仍要打开」即可。 截图或演示视频

projects.title: Show HN: Online curling game/SIM with Three.js
projects.author: nrjames
projects.summary: Hello! One of my hobbies is curling in a league with the local curling club. From time to time, there's a setup of stones that is tricky and interesting to contemplate from a strategic perspective. A while back, I started working on a three.js-based curling simulator that would enable me to recreate situations from my league games and then try different shots. As you may know, curling is notoriously tricky from a physics perspective. There are a variety of papers out there about this, including this one, which is one of the more recent dives into understanding why stones curl the way they do: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-018-26595-y Anyhow, with the help of Claude Code, I pulled together the work and converted the quick-and-dirty sim into a game you can play online. It's still a bit more of a sim than a game, perhaps, but it can be fun to play as a game. Curling often is referred to as "chess on ice" because there's more strategy in choosing shots and playing ends than there would appear to be at first glance. The primary challenge of turning this into a game has been trying to figure out how to provide the computer player both with a policy for game and end-level strategy while also having it evaluate the tactical choices that have to be made for each shot. For example, when would the computer try to blank (no points scored) an end deliberately so that it can retain hammer (last stone thrown) in the subsequent end? When should it throw a low vs. high center or corner guard in an attempt to make up a point deficit? When should it try to steal points from the hammer team vs. throwing protective stones that hold the hammer team to one point? It's a fun side project for me, so I thought you all might enjoy giving it a shot. :) p.s. In a game, if you go into the settings, you can turn on debug mode, which will reveal a panel on the right with a variety of (currently-undocumented) parameters you can tweak.

projects.title: Show HN: GhostFleet: A Battleship game with an advanced AI opponent
projects.author: anirbanhere
projects.summary: Hi HN I've always been drawn to puzzle and strategy games, and for a long time I've wanted to build a game of my own. While building my own version of battleship, I came across this idea of adding a super intelligent in-game AI which uses probability and statistics to reason with the board and fire its next shot. The goal was to create a set of rules & logic capable of consistently outperforming human players, much like chess engines that have evolved to surpass even the world's strongest human chess players. Thus I created WraithAI and named the game as Ghostfleet. WraithAI features: 1. Monte Carlo Simulation with Probability heatmaps: Before every turn WraithAI samples 800 possible enemy fleet configurations and aggregates them into a probability heatmap. It identifies the most likely locations of the enemy ships. 2. Bayesian Inference: After every shot it updates its beliefs and uses the information gain to draw a new heatmap. When two cells look equally likely WraithAI picks the one whose result would tell more about the hidden enemy fleet for its next turn. 3. Adaptive Strategy & defense: It adjusts its aggression based on the state of the game and has a mechanism which resists common search strategies. I would genuinely like to know how people can find patterns in its behavior. Can you outsmart & beat WraithAI? Ghostfleet also has multiplayer mode so you can play with your friends. There is a matchmaking component called TownSquare at the bottom through which you can share room codes with other players. You can play directly in your browser: 1. Play against WraithAI: https://ghostfleet.in/play?mode=wraithAI 2. Ghostfleet: https://ghostfleet.in/ 3. WraithAI Technical breakdown: https://ghostfleet.in/wraith-ai

projects.title: Show HN: Jam – A music making game where you play gigs to earn studio gear
projects.author: garrinm
projects.summary: The idea comes from Chrome Music Lab, which was addictive and satisfying. I felt it could be that fun and easy to put down musical ideas and hear them grow into something more substantial. Simple at first, but with progressively more depth if the player wants to go there. That was the seed, and it spiraled from there into Jam. You start with one instrument, and you write parts on a piano roll. Create your own music or play gigs (levels) to earn coins and buy more gear. Each gig is built around one musical idea, so you pick up some music knowledge as you go. Friends can join your studio with a link and write parts alongside you. In my other Show HNs I've always come with my own code. In this case I didn't write the code, but I'm still proud of the outcome and I hope some of you will enjoy it too. The audio code is Rust/WASM running in a worklet. This is the part I had prior experience in, and it's been fun getting that into a browser. The instruments are decent and the signal chains hold their own. The front end is the agent's own design in three.js. The optimization work there was interesting because of how busy the UI gets and how many elements come into view. I focused on measuring React renders per interaction, instruction counts for the audio engine, load times and frame times. The result is something that runs decently even on a phone. The multiplayer side is simple. Each studio is a Cloudflare Durable Object that holds the song. Players connect to it over a WebSocket and send small actions (add a note, turn a knob). The object applies each action, stores the result and sends the updated session to anyone else in the room. This simple setup allows collaborative music making out of the gate, even though it's not the game's main focus (yet). This is a beta: feedback, comments and criticisms are all welcome. You can get into the game with no signup, and if you want to save your progress you'll be prompted to enter an email address.

projects.title: Show HN: Klistra – Make launch videos and product demos, all in one AI studio
projects.author: pvarghav
projects.summary: I built Klistra: describe your video idea and add your logo, photos or other assets, Klistra designs and animates a video for you, exported for every screen size, with fonts, media and logos kept exact. Deterministic renders make features exact and isolated, allowing for superior control and iteration compared to diffusion models. Here's a short demo render where I made an ad for Klistra itself: https://app.klistra.ai/s/4EQoWCe37SkYz5nThgegzw As a solo dev with a lot of projects going on, I found myself needing to make short promos or explainer videos. Not being familiar with animation software, I had the idea to use Claude to code up those videos and export them as video files. In the process of creating these clips I stumbled into a bunch of bugs and setup needed to make it work reliably. The list of features I wanted for better control and feedback kept growing and I needed to sign up for a bunch of services to get music, voiceovers and other media into my project. I couldn't find an existing service that had everything I wanted. Seeing these hurdles and that the technology was only easily accessible to people already confident with coding agents, I started working on Klistra, and a couple of months later I'm turning it into a service so you all can use it too. The goal with Klistra was to include everything I missed in the manual workflow in an easy-to-use service with a nice UI, so people could focus on what they wanted the video to look like, not setting up the framework behind it. Klistra includes precise timeline control, media generation, built-in support to make animations match the rhythm of the background music, word extraction from voiceovers or songs, a dedicated iteration / feedback tool, website import and much more. Something I knew I needed to get right was making it easy to iterate on small features of the video with precise control of what was being built. I designed Klistra so you first create a specification where you define scenes in detail, describe what you want shown and when, reference media or timestamps in-line, freely drag the timeline around and preview the result before letting a builder agent create the video. If you want to change something, the specification changes and the builder agent gets a diff of what changed. There is also a planner agent built into Klistra that helps create and edit the specification for you (which is what I use the most), while letting you turn to manual fine-tuning when needed. Don't think of this as a replacement for diffusion models, if you want photorealistic images or videos they clearly do a better job. Klistra really shines when you need motion design and precise control, exact text with your fonts, media such as logos or voiceovers, animated UI that matches your apps and so on. Klistra does have built-in integrations for generating media from diffusion models, and combining the two technologies usually gets the best results. Everything that costs money to run on Klistra, from machines to AI tokens, is paid for with credits included in a subscription or bought via one-time packs (Pro starts at $25/mo ($20 billed yearly) and packs at $12). Being a solo dev without funding, the budget wouldn't allow for a free tier with enough monthly credits for a real project. I instead decided to give the first 200 of you who sign up 350 free credits, enough for a simple video (the advanced tutorial used around 250 credits). There is also a Claude Code integration in paid subscriptions, where your agent can act as a planner, convenient if you already have a project built with Claude that has all the context and you need an explainer, ad or social post. It also reduces credit spending if you're a heavy planner user. - Tutorial, mostly using the planner: https://klistra.ai/docs/basic - Advanced features and manual control: https://klistra.ai/docs/advanced - More demos: https://klistra.ai/ Happy to hear what you think!

projects.title: Show HN: Topothesy – a daily online geography game
projects.author: proy87
projects.summary: I'm not very good at geography and don't know the exact locations of many cities. That's why it is hard for me to play games where you have to pin cities precisely on a map. But what if you place cities relative to other cities? That's how idea of a puzzle was born: given a set of cities, choose any five and place them correctly relative to other on a 5x5 grid. The topmost city is the northernmost, the leftmost is the westernmost. There should be only one city in each row and column, since the cities are not strictly vertical or horizontal relative to each other. The goal of the game is to try to find the most compact set of cities. If cities are far from each other, it is quite easy to place them; on the other hand such set will be far from compact. It is much harder to find a compact set and to place it correctly. The main challenge in developing the game was to make it moderately difficult. It is quite easy to place Los Angeles and Sydney, but much harder to place Osaka and Kyoto. Another issue is to make it interesting every day: it is not interesting to place Zurich, Milan and Marseille too often. So, I want to ask: 1. Are the rules clear? Have you encountered some difficulties? 2. Is the game interesting? Is it too hard or too easy? 3. I feel that it can be used for learning, but I don't know how. Any ideas? Thank you very much in advance. The puzzle is available here: https://www.topothesy.com

projects.title: 做了个 Mac 小工具「淡出 DockQuit」：从 Dock 悬停点 × 或中键退出应用
projects.author: JULY235
projects.summary: 大家好，最近做了个 Mac 小工具，叫「淡出」（DockQuit），想来分享一下，也听听大家的意见。 它解决的是一个很小的问题：不用打开 Dock 的右键菜单，就能退出正在运行的应用。不替换原生 Dock，也不是强退或清理内存工具。 ### 两种手动操作，都是免费的 - 鼠标停在应用图标上，点出现的 ×。 - 用鼠标中键点击应用图标。 它发出的是正常退出请求，未保存内容仍由应用自己提示，不会替你点「不保存」，也不会在退出失败后升级为强退。 如果操作的是 Dock 中单独显示的最小化窗口缩略图，则会先还原，再关闭那一个窗口，而不是退出整个应用。收进应用图标里的窗口和浏览器标签页不在这个范围内。 ![淡出设置：悬停 ×、鼠标中键和可选自动退出](https://dockquit.heino.top/assets/screenshots/settings-zh-light-20261118.webp) ### 还有一个可选的自动退出 可以给指定应用开启：当它已经没有窗口，并且你切换到其他应用后，再请求正常退出。等待时间可以选立即、15、30 或 60 秒；「立即」也要先切走并完成检查，不是一关窗口就退出。 隐藏、最小化不算关窗。没有窗口也不代表没有后台任务，所以播放音乐、下载、编译这类应用，需要谨慎选择。 这一项可以在 App 内主动开启 7 天试用，中国大陆目前标价 29 元一次买断，税费和最终总额以结账为准。试用不会自动扣款，到期后手动退出和单窗口操作仍然免费。 给 V 友准备了 Auto-quit 的五折早鸟优惠码，需要的话在评论区留个言就可以领取。手动功能本身免费，不需要优惠码。 ![淡出自动退出设置：选择应用和等待时间](https://dockquit.heino.top/assets/screenshots/autoQuit-zh-light-20261118.webp) ### 安装和下载 需要开启辅助功能权限。官网提供 Developer ID 签名并公证的 DMG，系统要求 macOS 14+，提供 Universal 安装包。 官网和下载：[淡出 DockQuit](https://dockquit.heino.top/zh/) 如果你已经习惯 Command-Q，可能不需要它；如果更习惯用鼠标在 Dock 上处理应用，可以试试看。 也想听听大家的具体反馈：悬停 × 和中键哪种更顺手？应用退出与单窗口关闭会不会容易混淆？如果遇到误触、识别不准或不该退出的情况，也欢迎告诉我对应应用和系统版本。谢谢。

projects.summary: 这是一个专门面向 AI 编程助手（Claude Code、Cursor、Antigravity、Copilot）的轻量级 CLI 扫描器与 PostToolUse Hook 工具。它通过自动解析 pom.xml 与 build.gradle(.kts) 识别项目的 Java 与 Spring Boot 版本，在 AI 修改 .java 文件后 31ms 内自动拦截已被移除的 javax.、WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter、RestTemplate 等遗留写法，并引导替换为 Java 21+ 与 Spring Boot 3.x+ 现代写法。 亮点 版本自动门控，老项目零误报：若检测到项目为 Java 8/11 或 Spring Boot 2.x，自动跳过高版本规则；仅在 Boot 3.2+ 时提示使用 RestClient 替代 RestTemplate。 零第三方依赖与极速扫描：纯 Python 3.11+ 标准库实现，100% 本地离线运行，单文件 PostToolUse Hook 延迟中位数 31ms，1000 个 Java 文件扫描约 183ms。 按需检索而非堆砌提示词：主 SKILL.md 仅 4.1KB，支持 mjg search / mjg retrieve 按需调取 Before/After 示例与注意事项（含默认保留 CSRF 防护等安全规范）。

projects.title: Show HN: Goldcrest, a household financial model you fill in by talking
projects.author: tralfamadorian8
projects.summary: I built Goldcrest in Toronto for my own use in the hope it helps others. I've been discussing a rent vs buy scenario with my partner and found that it requires a surprising number of variables and complexity to do proper modelling/forecasting (the model implementation is a Monte-Carlo simulation under the hood). I then extended it to financial planning since most of the groundwork was already built from the rent vs buy model. I did look at some other financial planning tools and noticed that the main difference between all other tools and my workflow was that I was primarily interfacing with an LLM to discuss, learn, plan, and build my models vs filling out form inputs (rather tediously). So, I thought that could be something that other people would like to do as well. Most of my friends aren't in software, and if they use LLMs it's for fairly basic things. For me at least, it's easier to type into a chat, "Hey, I make $x/year, have a wife and kids, a house valued at $x, a TFSA/Roth IRA with $x, etc." Right now I have the chat agent prompting the user. It's a similar experience to how one might have a conversation with a financial advisor, however with slightly more guardrails (e.g. the LLM never does math, just translates your input to form inputs). The other tedious aspect of financial planning that I unfortunately can't solve right now is financial data integrations (investment platforms, banks, etc). So users have to collect their financials on their own for now. I also wanted to put an emphasis on privacy given my personal detest for companies that don't value it, so everything is pseudonymized (similar to anonymization). The model leverages open-source data to ensure everyone (well, USA and Canada at the moment) has a tailored forecast that calculates in-depth tax considerations for various registered investment accounts, full-time vs self-employed income, detailed future expense considerations and "events" like having a child or selling a house, Social Security/CPP/OAS, etc. Everything is also manually reviewable and configurable for users inclined to do so. I'm working on an educational aspect/feature so users can ask the LLM questions. I also have plans to expose an MCP for power users so you can hook-in with your own LLM. There's also a Sankey diagram for income breakdown. Everyone loves a Sankey diagram. Thanks for reading. I'd love to hear your thoughts and feedback.

projects.author: soundcloud-to-mp3
projects.summary: WAV AI 是一个在线的 AI 音乐生成和编辑工具。用一句话描述想要的曲子（风格、情绪、节奏），就可以生成原创配乐，不需要会乐理；也支持把图片转成音乐。比较适合做视频 BGM、播客垫乐、游戏和广告配乐，用来避开版权提示。 做视频、播客或游戏时，配乐经常卡在版权上：用现成曲子容易被平台提示，请人做又慢又贵。WAV AI 想解决的就是这件事：用一句话描述想要的曲子（风格、情绪、节奏、乐器），就可以生成原创配乐，不需要会乐理，也不用先找参考曲。 besides 文字生成，也支持把一张图转成音乐，适合已经有画面、还缺 BGM 的情况。 主要功能： 文字生成音乐：按风格、情绪、速度和乐器生成，也可以选择纯器乐（没有人声），比较适合做视频垫乐和背景音乐。 图片转音乐：上传一张图，根据画面气氛生成配乐。 生成之后还能继续改：可以把短片段无缝延长成完整曲子，做 Remix / Mashup，用分轨拆出人声和伴奏，再做母带处理。 内置编辑：可以改特定歌词、翻译歌词，或按视频节奏微调速度和结构，尽量让配乐贴上画面，而不用整首重做。 比较适合这几类用法：给 TikTok、YouTube 做相对安全的 BGM，给播客、游戏和短片配乐，或者给广告、店铺内容做可商用的配乐。有免费额度，可以先试用；付费方案支持商用，并导出 MP3 / WAV / FLAC。 大家可以试用下，给下优化意见：
