github.description: 浮屿：Windows 和 macOS 上的轻量灵动岛。在屏幕顶部汇总 QQ、微信和邮件通知，查看 Claude Code / Codex 的运行状态并直接在岛上审批，还有剪贴板历史、快捷翻译、音乐与歌词、待办、日历和文件中转，支持插件扩展。

projects.summary: 浮屿在屏幕顶部放一座小岛，平时收成一条，鼠标移上去展开。岛上有待办、剪贴板历史、QQ / 微信 / 邮件提醒、快捷翻译、音乐和歌词。 写代码时我用得最多的是 Agent 页：Claude Code、Codex 等十来家 AI 编程工具的会话哪个在跑、哪个在等确认，都列在岛上，审批可以直接在岛上点。 岛上放什么由插件决定，收起条、展开页、设置页都能用插件加内容，内置功能也在改成插件，每个人都能 DIY 自己的岛。开源（AGPL-3.0），Tauri 写的，收起时内存 16 MB 左右。

projects.title: MovExtra: Fitness Challenges
projects.summary: MovExtra: Move More. Live Extra. Make every step count with MovExtra, your fitness tracking, workout challenges, rewards, and wellness discovery app. Track your daily activity, build healthier habits, join fitness challenges, earn eligible rewards, discover fitness services, and connect with a community that helps you stay motivated.

projects.title: Velvet Alarm
projects.summary: Velvet Alarm taps your wrist as you start to stir, up to 30 minutes before your alarm time, so whoever sleeps next to you can sleep on. Not stirring? Your iPhone alarm rings at the time you chose, never later. It's an alarm clock, not a sleep tracker: no charts, no account, no ads, no servers. Your Health data stays on your iPhone and Apple Watch. Waking as you stir needs an Apple Watch worn to sleep; without one it's a plain, reliable iPhone alarm.

projects.title: AI Picture Generator
projects.summary: Turn text or photos into pictures with Vogoo. Set exact pixel sizes, explore creative templates, remove backgrounds and upscale images. Create visuals for social posts and designs in your browser.

projects.title: PLAYY india
projects.summary: PLAYY is India's hyperlocal sports platform: find games, grounds, teams and coaches near your PIN code, run tournaments and school or college leagues, score matches live and follow results for cricket, football, badminton, kabaddi and 40 more sports.

projects.title: Agent Co-Founder
projects.summary: Agent Co-Founder is Tinder for business growth. Every day it finds prospects, drafts email and LinkedIn outreach, writes follow-ups and replies, and creates blog and social posts. Each one lands in your queue as a card: swipe right to send or publish it, swipe left to skip it. Nothing goes out without your yes, unless you put a channel on autopilot.

projects.title: CIXLER
projects.summary: Your diary says one thing and your books say another. CIXLER joins Cliniko to Xero, works out what is holding your clinic back each week (the books, cash, margin, capacity or demand) and emails you a ranked list of what to do about it, with the money attached. Built for physiotherapy, osteopathy, chiropractic, podiatry and other allied health clinics. Free for 14 days.

projects.title: DearInside
projects.summary: One of the attractions at DearMate, a virtual AI theme park. 109 residents of your body — brain, heart, stomach, hormones — run their own social feed. Tell Rumi, the reporter, about your day, and they post their side: bills, reviews, petitions, gossip.

projects.title: SocialPostAI
projects.summary: Generate AI social media copy for Instagram, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, and Facebook. SocialPostAI is an AI social media post generator that writes platform-perfect copy in English and Chinese.

projects.title: GYMTION
projects.summary: Most fitness apps track sets and reps. GYMTION tracks the one thing that actually decides your progress: whether you showed up. • Automatic check-in via geofence when you enter your gym • Streak = gym visits • Friends see your check-ins • Free on iOS and Android.

projects.title: The Ultimate Free Screen Recorder
projects.summary: Capture a tab, window or screen, then polish the recording in your browser. Add spring zooms, auto-cut silence, speed ramps, callouts, privacy blur, music and camera overlays. Reframe for social formats and export MP4 or WebM up to 4K/60. No uploads, account, watermark or time limit. Never pay for a screen recording app ever again!

projects.title: Groovedesk
projects.summary: Groovedesk is the intelligent workspace for record labels and artist managers. Keep release plans, tasks, artist information and assets together. Turn your release checklists into reusable templates, assign work to your team, and shift related deadlines automatically when a release date changes. Draft marketing plans from your release context and give collaborators access to what they need. Less time on admin, more time for music.

projects.title: Final Battle Sim
projects.summary: Ever wonder who'd win — Spartans vs Samurai, modern armies head to head? Final Battle Sim lets you set up the fight and watch it resolve round by round, no strategy-game homework required. Pick your army, pick the battlefield, read the full Battle Report. Fully offline, no ads, no in-app purchases, no grind — $0.99 once, yours forever. From indie studio CG25 Ventures.

projects.title: HSK Studio
projects.summary: A free browser app for learning to read Chinese: paste any text, look up words in a built-in dictionary, save vocabulary, and review it with spaced repetition, plus daily word games.

### 008870.xyz An all-in-one Discord bot ecosystem for community engagement, moderation, and gaming. ### Key Modules * **Schedule Pro (SP)**: Event management with web builders and native countdowns * **Forum Assistant (FA)**: AI-powered Q&A and auto-triage for Discord forums. * **Number & Word Guess (NG/WG)**: Viral minigames powered by a global GP point economy.

projects.title: FeelFreak
projects.summary: FeelFreak is a social debate platform to share opinions, participate in 1v1 debates, vote in polls and connect to like minded communities. Score points, complete challenges and climb the leaderboard. Speak out. Challenge ideas. Be a freak.

projects.title: WebGeno
projects.summary: WebGeno is a browser-based genogram maker for therapists, psychologists and social workers. New since the first launch: complete McGoldrick notation, a Life Timeline, Presentation Mode, AI pattern flags, and German and Portuguese. Free plan; Pro from $12/month.

projects.title: GenioPlay
projects.summary: Ever had a test coming up and a child who just won't read the chapter one more time? GenioPlay turns those exact pages into a game. Take a few photos, and a minute or two later your child can play level 1 of a game on that topic, with guardians to beat. Or pick a ready-made game for math, logic, biology or geography. Free to start, no ads, nothing to install.

projects.title: Video Compressor: TinyReel
projects.summary: TinyReel makes large videos small enough to send, share or keep, without making them look bad. Pick a video from Photos or Files, or record a new one. See its size, resolution and length. Choose Quick presets (Low, Medium or High) or a size made for the messaging app, social site or email you're sending to, or switch to Custom for full control over bitrate, target file size and resolution. The app shows how big the new file will be before you start.

projects.title: Boredom Buster: Group Games
projects.summary: A pass-the-phone party game pack: Trivia, Charades, Acting Challenge and Hard Disagree (pick a side on silly arguments like "soup is round" and see if the room splits). 3,700+ cards. Free on iPhone, Android, and inside TikTok with no install.

projects.title: Voplica
projects.summary: Design characters with a consistent identity, then bring them into images, video, music, voices and full short films - all in one place.

projects.title: Hobby AI
projects.summary: Hobby AI is a free price guide and collection tracker for trading cards. It catalogs 17 card games, including Pokémon, One Piece, Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh!, Disney Lorcana and Riftbound, in English, Japanese and other Asian editions. Every priced card has a daily market estimate averaged across marketplaces, price history and weekly movers. Track unlimited collections, share them, set price alerts and get a monthly value report by email. Free forever.

projects.title: MobileStudio
projects.summary: MobileStudio is a mobile app that helps founders, developers, and designers turn ordinary screen recordings into professional app demo videos. Add phone mockups, zoom effects, custom backgrounds, music, and more. Create polished demos in multiple aspect ratios, ready to share anywhere.

projects.title: Sistema.fit
projects.summary: SistemaFit is a modern, high-performance fitness platform bridging the gap between athletes, personal trainers, and gyms. Log strength workouts with zero friction, assign personalized training programs, and streamline gym memberships and check-ins—all in one unified, beautifully designed app.

projects.title: RPGadget
projects.summary: RPGadget is a desktop toolkit for Game Masters on Windows. Bring in the rulebook you own for any RPG. RPGadget sorts your whole rulebook and makes it searchable. Nothing added, nothing removed. You are in full control. Build your world, its people and places, plan your campaign, and run the night from one desk. Your players join from their phones in any browser, at the table or across the country. Your books stay on your own PC. Try the free demo before you buy.

projects.title: Songlivo
projects.summary: Songlivo is a songbook and setlist app for live musicians. One device leads, the whole band follows: change the song and every screen turns in under a second, over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth, no internet. Transpose, auto scroll, pedal support. No account, no ads.

projects.title: DrawingEZ
projects.summary: DrawingEZ is a coloring app for iPhone and iPad where every page is a piece of a bigger picture. Color pieces to fill 18 world murals (336 pieces), learn to draw with 31 step-by-step lessons, play mini games, and pin your art on a shared globe. No account needed.

projects.title: SoundFlow
projects.summary: SoundFlow is a free open-source music player for Windows. Flutter UI over a Rust audio engine — no Electron — so it stays around 70-80 MB of RAM, while Spotify sits at 700-800 MB and SoundCloud at 150-200 MB. Search and stream from YouTube and SoundCloud, open Spotify track links, keep your library with playlists, favorites and history, import SoundCloud playlists, and see what's playing in Discord. A transparent floating Dock and Dynamic Island mini-player (Ctrl+Alt+M) keep it a keystroke away.

projects.title: Precedent
projects.summary: Create AI images, video, voices and music in one studio with 150+ models like Seedance 2.5, Veo 3.1, Nano Banana Pro and Eleven v3. Recast videos, animate avatars, lip sync and translate. Top up from $5, see the price before you generate. No subscription.

projects.title: Eventipix
projects.summary: Eventipix transforms weddings, parties and corporate events into interactive experiences. Guests scan a QR code to share photos, react and leave written, audio or video messages — no app or account required. Hosts can customize private galleries, display photos live, and engage guests with quizzes and multiplayer games. Eventipix Booth also turns an iPad into a connected photo booth, with photos and GIFs added directly to the event gallery.

projects.title: GameBuildMarket
projects.summary: GameBuildMarket is a marketplace for people who make and buy game, 3D and animation work: FiveM interiors and scripts, modular kits for Unreal, Unity and Godot, models and server packs. Buyers pay in USDC or USDT on Solana, and payment is held in escrow until the files are delivered. The platform fee is 10%. Verified sellers get a public badge, and listings show view and sold counts. A first house kit, Space Station Hydroponics, is live as a three-engine pack so you can see a listing end to end.

projects.title: Auto Organizer for Windows
projects.summary: Auto Organizer for Windows is a utility that keeps your PC folders tidy by itself. Once set up (about 2 minutes), it watches your Downloads, Desktop, Documents, Pictures, Videos and Music folders and moves every new file into a subfolder by type. It runs on the PowerShell built into Windows, so there is nothing to install. It never overwrites a file, never touches a file still downloading, and works 100% offline: no account, no cloud. One-time purchase, no subscription. Windows 10 and 11.

projects.title: Next3D
projects.summary: Transform text prompts or images into production-ready 3D models in seconds. Clean quad topology, 4K PBR textures, and native export to GLB, FBX, OBJ, STL, and USDZ for games, AR/VR, and 3D printing.

projects.title: Show HN: Riddle Roll – A 5MB marble physics puzzle game for Android
projects.author: koje71

projects.title: Merry Melody
projects.summary: Turn a name and shared memories into an AI-generated Christmas song and a digital musical card. Review the lyrics, compare two versions, and hear free 30-second previews. Unlock one version for $14.99 or both for $24.99, plus applicable tax. Share the finished card by link; buyers can download the MP3.

projects.title: Show HN: LooPo – A word completion game run in the browser
projects.author: yuzman
projects.summary: This is multiplayer word completion game and you play via other players online. - Press help and learn the very simple mechanics. - Play with AI at first to get the feel. - You can play with your family and friends with room code even if you don't register. - If you register, you can play random matches with other online players and get listed in rankings! English/Turkish are supported. Hope you like my game.

projects.title: playdesk
projects.summary: playdesk is game venue management software for snooker clubs, gaming lounges, bowling alleys and other venues that rent out space by the hour. It covers bookings, per-minute session billing, point of sale, customer wallets and staff.

projects.title: AI Calorie
projects.summary: AI calorie counter and food scanner app. Take a photo of your meal to get instant calories, protein, carbs and fat, and track your weight loss, muscle gain or healthy eating goals.

projects.title: TrackMyPaw: Dog Walk Tracker
projects.summary: TrackMyPaw is your whole pack's companion for walks and care - add all your dogs, record every adventure with GPS, keep meds, feeding, and health in one caring place, and discover pet-friendly places around you.

projects.title: SPIL
projects.summary: Ten free party games you play on your phones in the browser. One person starts a room, friends join with a four character code. Answer "Have you ever" questions in private, guess each other's score, then watch it spill. No app, no signup. Up to 12 players.

projects.title: Lines Recorder
projects.summary: Record dialogue on Windows for voice-over or language lessons. Paste a script to create your cast. In Continuous Recording, press R to save a take and start the next line. Import recordings, retake lines, edit clips, and loop music. Capture Zoom or Google Meet audio, convert voices with your ElevenLabs key, and export WAV or MP3.

projects.title: HookChecker
projects.summary: Upload a Reel, TikTok or Short draft. HookChecker reads the frames and the sound, then gives you a 0-100 hook score, notes pinned to exact seconds and one rewritten opening you can film now. Upload only, no social login, no view-count promises. 3 free reports.

projects.title: Hoot Me
projects.summary: Hoot Me helps you meet people in real life: find parties, hikes, dinners and gigs near you on a live map, join 100% selfie-verified people, and plan it all in the Event Hub -chat, polls, bill splits, shared photos. Free on iOS & Android, in 12 languages. Discover social events near you. Join the fun, meet new people, and hoot about it.

projects.title: ScholarVerse by Whole Living Academy
projects.summary: Planning engaging, culturally relevant school days takes time. ScholarVerse helps homeschooling families and educators with ready-to-use K–12 learning centered on the African American experience and wider African world. Explore complete school days, interactive lessons, educational games, virtual labs, coding, flight simulations, and progress tracking. Perfect for homeschooling, afterschool enrichment, and independent learning. Start with a free Daily Quest at myscholarverse.com.

projects.title: Show HN: Play retro games on an Eastern European-inspired setup
projects.author: bitheap_tech
projects.summary: POV: It's November 2004, you just came back from school and want to play some games on your old PC.

projects.title: Neurnova
projects.summary: Neurnova is a multi-model AI workspace for developers and creators. Switch between AI assistants for chat and coding, explore image, video, music, and 3D creation tools, and use Astral Cloud for supported compute tasks. Start with the free experience; additional tools and usage are available on premium plans.

projects.title: SafeSet
projects.summary: SafeSet builds a workout plan around your back, knee, neck or shoulder pain. It asks where it hurts, leaves risky moves out, and if an exercise hurts mid-workout, one tap on "It hurts" swaps in a safer move for the same muscle. Also: daily readiness check, photo calorie estimates, cycle-aware training, Apple Health. 30 languages, free core plan.

projects.title: SmartPoli
projects.summary: SmartPoli helps you manage healthcare and care for your loved ones, even from a distance. Keep track of medications, reminders, emergency information, and health updates — all in one place. Built for patients and the families who care. Join our waitlist for early access!

projects.title: Flicknivo
projects.summary: Flicknivo is a free browser-based reaction time challenge for gamers. Test your reflexes, view your average response time, compare scores, and challenge your friends.

projects.title: Social Media Reminder
projects.summary: Running a business is enough work without having to think about social media every day. SMR is your AI-powered helping hand. It learns about your business, creates branded content, adapts posts for different platforms, helps plan and publish your content, and reminds you what needs doing. Spend less time figuring out what to post and more time running your business.

projects.title: O Meu Financeiro
projects.summary: O Meu Financeiro is a finance tool for restaurants and food businesses in Brazil. It pulls bank statements through Open Finance, brings in iFood and 99Food payouts, and lets owners log expenses with a WhatsApp message, a voice note or a photo of the invoice. From that it builds cash flow, a P&L, payables and receivables, so owners can see whether the business is healthy without spreadsheets or accounting skills. In Portuguese, with a 14-day free trial and no credit card required.

projects.title: Instant Wheel
projects.summary: Instant Wheel is a free toolkit for random decisions, picking names, generating teams and rolling dice. Create, save, share and embed custom wheels. Perfect for classrooms, games and everyday decisions. No account required.

projects.title: BirdsGalaxy
projects.summary: BirdsGalaxy is a free worldwide community app for bird lovers — a social network for bird keepers and breeders. Share reels, manage your aviary, predict mutations, and buy and sell safely. https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.birdsgalaxy.app

projects.title: Kotoba Ciphers
projects.summary: Kotoba Ciphers is a cryptogram puzzle game built on real philosophical quotes. Each puzzle hides a line from Sun Tzu, Lao-Tzu, Confucius, Musashi, Bashō, Marcus Aurelius, Seneca or Epictetus behind a letter-substitution cipher. Crack the code, then reflect on what you decoded. What stands out: - Daily challenge plus easy, medium and hard modes - 240+ puzzles in English and French - No account needed, just open and play - The ancient wisdom that inspired anime and manga

projects.title: AiCore
projects.summary: AiCore turns a talking-head video filmed on your phone into a ready-to-post Reel, TikTok or Short in about 5 minutes. The AI writes a screenplay for your words and adds subtitles in your language (built for Kazakh and Russian), motion graphics, beat-synced music, sound effects and 3 post captions. Your own voice stays. No video yet? It writes a script for its built-in teleprompter. Your first video is free.

projects.title: RunTune
projects.summary: RunTune is a music player designed for walking and running. The playback speed of your music changes in real-time based on your movement speed. [Key Features] Speed-Linked Playback: The music tempo adjusts to your running pace, supporting your workout rhythm. Customizable Settings: You can set specific speed thresholds and adjust the playback speed ratios to your preference. Local File Playback: Play your favorite music files stored directly on your device.

projects.title: Money and Macros
projects.summary: Money & Macros puts your budget, macros, and recipes in one app, so you stop running a money app next to a food tracking and recipe app. Snap a restaurant check and the app tells you the tip and total, then calculates macros from the same pic. Snap a plate and macros are logged. Import recipes by picture or social share. Snap the pantry and fridge to get matching recipes. Tag business expenses by Schedule C line, then export the year. Optional read-only bank sync. Free 7-day Pro trial, no card.

projects.title: 【软件自荐】Telo：在 Codex 或 Claude Desktop 里查询自己的 Apple 健康记录
projects.author: weiweiwang
projects.summary: 自荐一个个人健康应用 Telo。我在做这个项目，想分享它在 Apple 健康和桌面 AI 助手之间的连接方式。 Telo 在 iPhone 和 Apple Watch 上把睡眠、心率变异性和锻炼记录整理到同一处，还可以用健康日志补充当天发生的事。连接 Codex 或 Claude Desktop 后，可以问「过去两周，我的睡眠和锻炼有什么变化？」助手使用的是用户同步到 Telo、并单独授权给它的数据。授权时需要在 iPhone 上生成配对码。 官网有应用演示、App Store 下载和两个桌面助手的安装说明：

projects.title: TrackClash
projects.summary: A free, ad-free music quiz: name the song from a short clip, challenge your friends on the same clips and climb the ELO leaderboard. No sign-up needed.

projects.title: Bambl
projects.summary: The modern all-in-one platform for Digital Business Cards and Link in Bio pages. Share social channels, portfolio, videos, and save contacts instantly with zero apps.

projects.title: Crownfall Kingdoms
projects.summary: Build a kingdom, raise soldier and spy forces, raid rivals, and team up with your alliance to take down timed, multi-phase Epic Battles. A persistent fantasy strategy game from tiny indie studio Angry Old Wizards. Free on iPhone.

projects.title: Perkox Offerwall SDK
projects.summary: Perkox is developer-first rewarded monetization for mobile apps and games. 95% of your users never buy. Perkox monetizes them without interrupting a session. One SDK, every platform Android, iOS, React Native, Flutter, Unity and Web. The offerwall UI ships with the SDK. Rewards that cannot be faked Validated server-side: signed postbacks, device checks, replay protection. It looks like your app Your logo, your currency, your colours. Free. Weekly payouts. No contract.

projects.title: Kindred
projects.summary: Events, chats, friendships, community and games with people who share your values. A values-first place for real relationships. Dating is optional.

projects.title: UndoSocial
projects.summary: UndoSocial is a Chrome extension for removing TikTok reposts, likes, and favorites in bulk. You can filter videos by keyword, choose how many items to remove, and set how long to wait between removals. The cleanup runs in your browser.

projects.title: Paisible AI
projects.summary: Paisible AI is an AI marketing assistant for small businesses: it writes and publishes social posts, handles Google reviews and runs ads from one chat.

projects.title: HealthyPlate
projects.summary: AI-powered mobile app that analyzes food photos to provide food recognition, estimated nutrition, and general food insights.

projects.title: Reelato
projects.summary: Write a one-line idea and Reelato makes the whole reel: script, AI images, native-sounding narration, captions and music. 30 or 60 seconds, vertical HD, in 29 languages from Spanish and Portuguese to Korean and Arabic. First reel free; plans from US$5 a month.

projects.title: digital marketing analyst in kannur
projects.summary: I'm Hrithwik Nath, a freelance digital marketing analyst in Kannur, helping businesses grow online with SEO and social media marketing.

projects.title: Utilixo
projects.summary: 56 个免费工具，覆盖文本处理、财务计算、健康换算、单位转换与内容生成，提供 7 种语言。所有工具都在浏览器本地运行，无需注册，也不会上传或保存你输入的内容。打开即用，无需安装或设置。

projects.title: SocialScrape
projects.summary: SocialScrape returns profiles, posts, comments and transcripts from 29 platforms as JSON through one API key, including TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, X and Reddit. Posts share one shape, so you write one parser. 100 free credits, no card.

projects.title: Weather Friends
projects.summary: A live painted sky for a real city. Weather telemetry and local data set the scene: clouds, rain, snow, aurora, sun and moon. Music made by code changes with the sky. Nine small friends visit the corner. Nine cities live; suggest the next.

projects.title: Pulso
projects.summary: Pulso is a Mac monitor for developers. Memory, swap and free disk in the menu bar; music, a Pomodoro timer and your Claude Code sessions in the notch; and a bottom bar that can replace the Dock. One-time payment, no account, under 1% CPU.

projects.title: Eyebrow
projects.summary: Eyebrow turns the notch into a live strip for music, volume, downloads, timers, meetings and Claude Code, and opens into a shelf, clipboard history and 18 widgets. Free on the Mac App Store; Pro is a one-time $4.99 with a 3-day trial.

projects.title: Apateon
projects.summary: Play board and party games with friends, everyone on their own phone or browser. Share a 4-letter room code and play Impostor, Stop, The Mind, Take 6, Battleship and 17 more. Bots fill empty seats. Free, no sign-up, no ads.

projects.title: FlagDecker
projects.summary: FlagDecker is a free browser game: a flag-themed roguelike deckbuilder and auto-battler. Each round you draft countries from the shop and build a scoring nation. Neighbouring countries that share a land border link together, and flags from the same continent add a bonus. Then the boards battle on their own. Eight players enter a match; the last nation standing wins, or the run ends after 15 rounds. You can play immediately with no account, on a phone or a computer.

projects.title: VinylAI
projects.summary: VinylAI is one app for record collectors and record shops. Take a photo of a record's cover or label, or scan its barcode, and it identifies the exact pressing. Keep your collection and wishlist, export to CSV, and play albums on an animated turntable through Spotify or Apple Music. Buy and sell on VinylAI Market with 0% commission, find record stores near you, and ask the AI assistant anything. Shops get VinylAI Business free: scan, grade, price and their own website.

projects.title: TapIn for Clinics
projects.summary: For therapy practices with no front desk. A client taps their therapist's name on the waiting-room iPad and only that therapist gets a silent push on their phone or Apple Watch. 5-minute setup, no health data stored, from $5.99/mo.

projects.title: Opinion
projects.summary: Opinion is a free social network for opinion polls, made for Brazil. Vote with one tap, no account needed, and see the results right away. Then compare how each age group, gender and region voted. Ask anything with your own polls, follow people and join the conversation in the comments. Votes are private: nobody sees how you voted, and groups with fewer than 5 votes stay hidden. On the web and on iOS, in Portuguese.

projects.title: Maity 1.0
projects.summary: No media team? Maity lends a mighty hand! 💪 Meet your AI-powered social media team. Maity turns your ideas, photos, and footage into professional, on-brand content for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and beyond. From creative planning to polished, music-synced videos, Maity handles the heavy lifting while keeping your brand authentic. No editing skills, expensive agencies, or endless prompting required. Your brand. Your story. Mighty results. 🚀

projects.title: VibeMatch
projects.summary: VibeMatch is a music-first dating platform accessible on the web. It matches singles through shared musical taste, top artists, and audio previews.

projects.title: Trading Agents
projects.summary: Enter a ticker and 12 LLM agents go to work. Analysts pull NASDAQ-licensed prices, company fundamentals, news, and social media; researchers argue both sides; risk agents stress-test the call. You get a BUY/HOLD/SELL recommendation, every data call made, and each agent's report.

projects.title: Oggo Game Hub
projects.summary: Oggo is a free live gaming hub and AI-friendly: it has its own MCP server (oggo.gg/mcp) for Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor. 14,000+ live GTA V (FiveM), RedM and CS2 servers with real player counts, live Twitch and Kick streams with multistream, a fact-checked GTA VI launch hub (Nov 19, 2026), 300+ guides, 14 free tools, 33 games, 18 languages. No sign-up.

projects.title: GlimsePlatform
projects.summary: Search for people, businesses, suppliers and creators worldwide, or ask any question and get an instant AI answer. Publish a free profile with all your social links, use image search to verify photos, and connect safely through built-in messaging.

projects.title: Santa Has Disappeared
projects.summary: Santa has disappeared — and Christmas is in 24 hours! Santa Has Disappeared is a free, print-and-play mystery game for 4 to 6 players (about 30 minutes). Print the PDF at home, hand out the character sheets, and let your guests investigate: who saw Santa last, and what really happened at the North Pole? It's the free starter game from Petits Plaisirs des Fêtes, a small Québec shop with 800+ printable party games, Advent calendars and murder mystery kits in up to 9 languages.

projects.title: Best Headphones for Music
projects.summary: A headphone leaderboard with no reviews and no paid spots. We screened 88,909 public comments and 13,749 store reviews, then counted how many real people recommend each of 31 pairs. Every number is a count you can check, and the complaints are shown too.

projects.title: FaceMint
projects.summary: FaceMint generates lifelike 1024 x 1024 portraits of completely fictional adults, with no prompt writing. Use them as placeholder avatars, in mockups, for character art or game NPCs. Every portrait is labelled 'AI-generated, not a real person'. So I built Matchday. It streamlines all of that, keeping you up to date with all of your teams' games right from your own calendar. Not another app, just a calendar I already look at every day, and the games stay up to date on their own. I tried to make a straightforward UX (and probably failed): You pick your teams, set an optional name for the calendar feed, select the Calendar type, then subscribe in it. In case of European clubs, you can mark them as "follow everywhere" and you get all their different cup games as well. Currently it supports men's and women's football, NHL, NBA, WNBA, and NFL. If somebody is interested, following a national football team is completely free, no email is needed. Otherwise, at least an email is required. I started building it for the World Cup, and was quite popular amongst my friends and colleagues but it is still a super small side project and I would appreciate any feedback, especially on the UX side.

projects.title: 一天上线了一个 Roblox 新游戏的资料站
projects.author: yuchuan520
projects.summary: 最近 Roblox 上有个 JoJo 题材的新游戏 Stand Out 很火，同时在线 5 万多人，官方 Discord 17 万多成员。这类 Roblox 游戏的官方资料一般放在 Trello 上，但 Trello 的内容在 Google 里几乎搜不到（搜索结果只显示 "No information is available for this page"），手机上翻 1000 多张卡片也很痛苦。 所以做了一个非官方的资料站：https://standout-trello.com 目前有这些内容： - 兑换码：按官方 Trello 里 Active / Expired 两个分组来区分，附兑换步骤和"码用不了"排查表 - 全部 Stand：45 个已上线的 Stand，可按稀有度筛选，写了每个怎么获得 - 箭的种类：6 种道具的合成配方、排除的稀有度、官方公布的概率 - 更新日志、Wiki 索引、Discord 真假辨别 几个做的时候的体会： 1. 数据准确比内容多重要。上线当天官方就换了一块新 Trello 板，旧板停更；同一天还有 3 个兑换码过期。好几个竞品站还把过期码列成可用。所以每个页面底部都列了数据来自哪几张 Trello 卡片、什么时候核对的，读者可以自己点过去验证。 2. Trello 公开板可以直接读 JSON（/1/boards/{id}/cards），写了个同步脚本，只更新事实字段，人工补充的内容保留不覆盖。 3. 技术栈：Next.js 静态导出 + Cloudflare Pages，代码放 GitLab。整站静态，移动端 Lighthouse 基本都在 97–100。下一步准备用 Cloudflare 定时触发重新构建，构建时自动拉 Trello 数据，这样兑换码过期能几小时内同步。 站是非官方的，和开发团队没有关系。欢迎提意见，也欢迎做游戏站的朋友交流。

projects.summary: 一套 A 股 30 分钟级别的缠论买卖点引擎（分型→笔→线段→中枢→一买/二买/三买），配套完整交易系统与纸面回测工具，同时是可被 AI 助手加载的 Agent Skill。它最有意思的不是策略，而是验证方法：用截断重算证明引擎没有前视偏差，用黄金快照防止规则被悄悄改动，用突变检验证明测试真的能抓到 bug。作者在 README 里主动写明：回测证据不支持「买点本身有优势」。 亮点 1. 无前视验证：把数据截到任意时刻重算，已发出的信号必须与全量跑一致，这条断言常驻 CI 2. 突变检验：手动把引擎改坏 20 处，19 个有效突变全部被测试抓住；第 20 个经 20 万条随机序列证明是等价突变，不算漏网 3. 诚实的边界：README 专设一节写明「这套规则的优势来自挑票，不是买卖点本身」，并给出全市场候选逐笔 −0.116R 的实测 4. 2 分钟离线自检：不需要任何行情数据、不联网，就能验证工程正确性 5. 纸面记账，没有券商接口，不会下真单；附完整免责声明

github.description: Open-source Mac app for writing novels and books: plain Markdown files, versions, typeset PDF and EPUB. A native Scrivener and Ulysses alternative, with an AI editor that never writes for you.

projects.summary: I’m writing my first novel and could not find an app that fit my workflow: quiet like iA Writer, organized like Scrivener, and with AI so I can discuss my book while I write it. It allows me to feel less “alone” and have a sounding board while I write. - A book is a folder of plain Markdown files. Musset commits to a git repo, tracks versions and drafts without you having to know git. - Revisions are CriticMarkup inside the text. It manages docx revisions too, so your editor can edit a Word doc and you import their comments. - PDFs are typeset using Typst, embedded in the app, following each language’s typographic rules. - Spelling and grammar are checked using LanguageTool, also embedded. - Mac/Word, WordStar, vi and Emacs keyboard modes. The AI is optional and uses your Codex or Claude Code CLI. It comments, leaves margin notes, and checks continuity and your chapters against your style rules. It’s GPL-3.0 and free during the beta. When or if it reaches 1.0, if there is sufficient interest, the idea is to make it a small one-time payment ($9.90). There is a paid sync service (git hosting) that lets you share a book with beta readers and editors. Download: https://musset.app I’d love to have some feedback!

projects.summary: 一个单文件 Python 脚本，读 SillyTavern 导出的 JSONL 或 OpenAI 风格的 role/content 日志，统计十类常见毛病的条数与证据：末尾原地绕圈、句中重复、半句截断、替用户说话、模板套话、开头雷同、越聊越长、上下文吃紧、预设缺行为规范、采样参数自相矛盾。输出一份 Markdown 清单，每条都给证据行和最小改法，并回答「该不该训 LoRA」——大多数时候答案是先别训。 亮点 不联网、不调模型 API、不需要账号：纯静态分析，输入就是你自己导出的记录。 每条判据都能追问：报告里给的是「第几条回复、原句、为什么命中」，不是打分。 把「先改哪一处」写进报告：同一个症状，提示词、检索、采样参数、微调的修法完全不同，它按性价比排序。 116 项内置自检（--selftest），阈值都写在代码里，可以按自己的样本改。 认两种日志格式：mes/isuser（酒馆原生）与 role/content（OpenAI 风格），后者只认 user/assistant/system 且 role: tool 记为读不出，不猜。 已知边界写在 README：只认字面重复，同义改写抓不到；阈值是经验值而非论文结论。

projects.title: Show HN: Trichroma, a Platformer of Light
projects.author: namirsab
projects.summary: Hi Hackernews! I just wanted to share a game I've made over a few weeks just as a little side project. Of course it was developed using Agents Engineering. The idea of the game though comes from around 10 years ago, from conversations with my brother: he is an artist and back them he was experimenting with chromatic paintings that looked differently depending on which color of light they were exposed to. A few weeks ago I decided to show my brother what's possible now a days with AI and how we can turn ideas into reality with a fraction of the effort we would have need in the past. The game is a little platformer, meant to be challenging but cute and entertaining, taking inspiration of games like Celeste or Meatboy. Death is part of the game, and light mechanics are introduced over the course of the 63 levels that are available to play. The development was made fully from my phone with Claude Code, but I invested lots of time on play testing it and I've involved several friends to play it to gather feedback and improve it. I'd love to hear your feedback and I hope some of you have fun playing it!

projects.title: Show HN: Prediction market competition where only agents can trade
projects.author: TNNick
projects.summary: Hi HN. I’ve been working on a project called Vaticin (with an i). Interested in your feedback. Vaticin is a prediction market competition platform where only agents are allowed to make wagers. Humans can’t directly do so themselves. There’s no real-money wagering involved. Vaticin is built for competition, research, and education. Every Monday morning, our LLM generates about 300 yes/no prediction questions across six categories: sports, finance, tech, entertainment, geopolitics, and science. The competition window runs Monday through Saturday, although some predictions won’t resolve for several weeks later. Agents take positions/allocations throughout the week, and then wagering locks on Saturday. Odds are live/dynamic and update with every new wager. Then a new competition cycle starts the next Monday. We have a live leaderboard that refreshes as our LLM resolves prediction questions each night (with human moderation of resolutions). Recognizing the value of existing prediction market competition platforms, we wanted to focus on forecasting models that are not only well-calibrated, but also make good market decisions and integrate game theory into their strategy. On Vaticin, agents have to decide which markets to take positions on, when to take a position, and how much to allocate. With the dynamic odds, agents have to adapt throughout the competition cycle. Vaticin measures more than raw prediction accuracy. We built a few ways to build an agent. Beginners can use our no-code “agent builder” and choose which forecasting parameters/strategies they want to use, then Vaticin codes their agent, shows the user the code, but allows them to edit the code. I hope it will help beginners learn more about coding and AI agents. More experienced builders can connect their own agents through an API. We added private tournaments, where users can create their own tournaments with their own prediction questions and fantasy tournaments where “captains” can recruit a team of agents from other users. Separate leaderboards. We’re still building, and recognize the site isn’t “perfect” yet, but the weekly competitions/private tournaments/fantasy tournaments are live. I’d really appreciate feedback on a few things: - Is Vaticin’s market-based/gamified format different enough from existing forecasting competitions to be relevant? - How would you score and rank agents over the long term? We use metrics like Brier score vs the market with adjustments for wager sample size. What else should we consider? - What features would make you interested in entering an agent into the competition? - Would private/custom tournaments be useful for classes, research groups, hackathons, or recruiting? - How should we discourage human users from hand-picking their “autonomous” agents’ bets? For Vaticin-hosted agents we can log every code edit, but we aren’t sure how to integrate that into the agent ratings. For self-hosted agents we can’t track this at all. Any insight into how other bot leagues (poker, algo trading, etc) handle this? Leaderboard: https://www.vaticin.ai/leaderboard Note: Early in the competition week, the leaderboard will show many agents at or close to their starting 100,000-token balance because a lot of positions haven't been resolved yet (and tokens are deducted when a wager is made, so the leaderboard will show many agents with less than their initial 100,000 token allocation). Markets: https://www.vaticin.ai/markets Note: The prediction questions are only visible when the weekly competition cycle is open, so if you visit on the weekend that page may be empty. You can pull up prior weeks’ predictions to take a look. Agent builder: https://www.vaticin.ai/build-an-agent Everything is free right now. No ads. Happy to answer questions. Thanks for any feedback, good or bad. Thanks!

projects.title: Show HN: Online curling game/SIM with Three.js
projects.author: nrjames
projects.summary: Hello! One of my hobbies is curling in a league with the local curling club. From time to time, there's a setup of stones that is tricky and interesting to contemplate from a strategic perspective. A while back, I started working on a three.js-based curling simulator that would enable me to recreate situations from my league games and then try different shots. As you may know, curling is notoriously tricky from a physics perspective. There are a variety of papers out there about this, including this one, which is one of the more recent dives into understanding why stones curl the way they do: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-018-26595-y Anyhow, with the help of Claude Code, I pulled together the work and converted the quick-and-dirty sim into a game you can play online. It's still a bit more of a sim than a game, perhaps, but it can be fun to play as a game. Curling often is referred to as "chess on ice" because there's more strategy in choosing shots and playing ends than there would appear to be at first glance. The primary challenge of turning this into a game has been trying to figure out how to provide the computer player both with a policy for game and end-level strategy while also having it evaluate the tactical choices that have to be made for each shot. For example, when would the computer try to blank (no points scored) an end deliberately so that it can retain hammer (last stone thrown) in the subsequent end? When should it throw a low vs. high center or corner guard in an attempt to make up a point deficit? When should it try to steal points from the hammer team vs. throwing protective stones that hold the hammer team to one point? It's a fun side project for me, so I thought you all might enjoy giving it a shot. :) p.s. In a game, if you go into the settings, you can turn on debug mode, which will reveal a panel on the right with a variety of (currently-undocumented) parameters you can tweak.

projects.title: Show HN: Jam – A music making game where you play gigs to earn studio gear
projects.author: garrinm
projects.summary: The idea comes from Chrome Music Lab, which was addictive and satisfying. I felt it could be that fun and easy to put down musical ideas and hear them grow into something more substantial. Simple at first, but with progressively more depth if the player wants to go there. That was the seed, and it spiraled from there into Jam. You start with one instrument, and you write parts on a piano roll. Create your own music or play gigs (levels) to earn coins and buy more gear. Each gig is built around one musical idea, so you pick up some music knowledge as you go. Friends can join your studio with a link and write parts alongside you. In my other Show HNs I've always come with my own code. In this case I didn't write the code, but I'm still proud of the outcome and I hope some of you will enjoy it too. The audio code is Rust/WASM running in a worklet. This is the part I had prior experience in, and it's been fun getting that into a browser. The instruments are decent and the signal chains hold their own. The front end is the agent's own design in three.js. The optimization work there was interesting because of how busy the UI gets and how many elements come into view. I focused on measuring React renders per interaction, instruction counts for the audio engine, load times and frame times. The result is something that runs decently even on a phone. The multiplayer side is simple. Each studio is a Cloudflare Durable Object that holds the song. Players connect to it over a WebSocket and send small actions (add a note, turn a knob). The object applies each action, stores the result and sends the updated session to anyone else in the room. This simple setup allows collaborative music making out of the gate, even though it's not the game's main focus (yet). This is a beta: feedback, comments and criticisms are all welcome. You can get into the game with no signup, and if you want to save your progress you'll be prompted to enter an email address.

projects.title: Show HN: Foolscap – a writing app that reads your book and never writes for you
projects.author: atugard
projects.summary: People are scared of their ability to write and think atrophying, so I wondered: what if I built something that enhanced human creativity instead of destroying it by doing the thinking and writing for people? Foolscap is the result, or at least the first version of that idea that's fleshed out enough to share here. It reads as you write and picks out the structure: characters, ideas, threads, what's left hanging. You can respond to what it picks out, so there's a dialectic between the system and you as the writer. There's also an agent on the side, plugged into the same system, so you can ask about your book and fire off actions through conversation. It never writes into your work. The system can also follow theorems and proofs and string together their dependencies, but I haven't made that a focus yet. There's no Lean support, for example. If anyone's interested in that, I'd love to hear it. I want to build this by iterating with the people who use it: a tool that uses AI not to bypass the creative process, but to bring new tools to it. There's a free tier, and if you email hello@foolscap.works I'll send you a code for 50% off. This is my first product, so feedback of any kind is welcome. Thanks, David

projects.title: Show HN: An API for word timestamps from speech, 75% within 20ms
projects.author: jasperstory
projects.summary: Hey HN, we're Yarn (W24) and we make a video editing app for startups, and we built Quebec ( https://quebec.yarn.so ), an API that gives you accurate word timestamps from speech. We needed it because cutting a word even 50ms off from its true timing can ruin talking head footage (examples in the write up). Accurate word timestamps usually come from a forced aligner, which takes the speech audio and a transcript and works out exactly when each word starts and ends. We weren't satisfied with the accuracy of Montreal Forced Aligner (MFA) or new models like ElevenLabs Cue ( https://elevenlabs.io/blog/cue-aligner ). Giving LLMs access to a waveform/spectrogram didn't help much either. So we built our own. There are two particularly interesting parts: - We wrote our own decoder around MFA's acoustic model that only lets each word land within 200ms of the rough timings. That made search small enough to solve exactly, so we don't need to use MFA's beam search. - We added a small CNN, built on the first two layers of Whisper Tiny, that nudges each word boundary by up to 50ms. We couldn't find enough hand-labelled speech that allowed for commercial use, so we had Gemini label our own (17k word boundaries). It took a couple of hours and cost under $200. A net trained on Gemini's labels scored the same as one trained on human labels (73.9% vs. 74%). One way to measure accuracy is % of word boundaries within 20ms of hand labels. Here are the results on Buckeye (hand-labelled American speech that we didn't train on): - Quebec 75% - MFA 61% - ElevenLabs Cue 30% If you want to try it, it's free until tomorrow night. You can point your agent at our docs at https://quebec.yarn.so , and send audio on its own or with your own transcript. After that, it costs $0.32 per hour with no signup (minimum $10 top-up). We serve it at cost. Caveats: only tested in English and slower than ElevenLabs. Let us know if Quebec works well for you, and send us any samples that work badly (you can email support at yarn dot so). Also let us know if you've built or found a better aligner. In theory we would just switch to a better aligner, although we would probably just push a bit harder to make ours better. Thanks! Jasper

projects.title: Show HN: Darkroomfinder.org – A Directory of Photography Darkrooms
projects.author: stokesj84
projects.summary: I built darkroomfinder.org, a directory of photography darkrooms, as a React single page app (SPA), because I wanted to understand how SPAs work and I wanted to scale to hundreds or thousands of cities without managing routes and pages for each of them. The site currently lists over 350 darkrooms across over 50 countries. However in deciding to build a SPA I failed to realize the downsides of SPAs for SEO. As an SPA darkroomfinder.org only has one route, i.e. darkroomfinder.org. Therefore GoogleBot only indexes the root domain and if someone searches for "Darkrooms" the site might surface in Google Search, but if a user searches "San Francisco Darkrooms" Google Search is much less likely to return darkroomfinder.org as nothing indicates the site has information about San Francisco. Solving this SEO problem while maintaining the simplicity of the SPA turned out to be a challenge but I think I have arrived at a solution that checks most of the desired boxes at the cost of being tied more closely to Cloudflare's infrastructure. Cloudflare, the DNS and CDN for darkroomfinder.org, has a serverless primitive, Cloudflare Workers. These Cloudflare Workers are distributed at the edge, have KV caches, and can intercept specific paths. So my solution to having both an SPA and indexable city routes is to have Cloudflare Workers cache the city data and intercept city routes directed at darkroomfinder.org returning an HTML page with the city data and the full React SPA which boots over the HTML page. So technically it's one SPA served to many routes. GoogleBot in traversing one of these city routes, like darkroomfinder.org/san-francisco, will index the HTML page while humans using browsers receive the same HTML which the React SPA boots over. Part of the project that remains unsolved is data collection and validation. Darkroom discovery is automated by agents running daily scans for unlisted darkrooms. But a human still has to validate that the discovered darkrooms exist and try to determine what capabilities they have such as B&W or color developing etc. I am currently working on an automated reachability and vitality checker to determine if the darkrooms already in the directory are still active, since photography darkrooms sometimes cease operations long before taking down their websites or social feeds. darkroomfinder.org

projects.summary: 一套 A 股 30 分钟级别的缠论买卖点引擎（分型→笔→线段→中枢→一买/二买/三买），配套完整交易系统与纸面回测工具，同时是可被 AI 助手加载的 Agent Skill。它最有意思的不是策略，而是验证方法：用截断重算证明引擎没有前视偏差，用黄金快照防止规则被悄悄改动，用突变检验证明测试真的能抓到 bug。作者在 README 里主动写明：回测证据不支持「买点本身有优势」。 亮点 1. 无前视验证：把数据截到任意时刻重算，已发出的信号必须与全量跑一致，这条断言常驻 CI 2. 突变检验：手动把引擎改坏 20 处，19 个有效突变全部被测试抓住；第 20 个经 20 万条随机序列证明是等价突变，不算漏网 3. 诚实的边界：README 专设一节写明「这套规则的优势来自挑票，不是买卖点本身」，并给出全市场候选逐笔 −0.116R 的实测 4. 2 分钟离线自检：不需要任何行情数据、不联网，就能验证工程正确性 5. 纸面记账，没有券商接口，不会下真单；附完整免责声明

projects.summary: 先说明：自荐，产品是 make1day AI SaaS Template，卖的是生成出来的源码。 [我为什么做这个] 买过几个 SaaS boilerplate，问题都一样： 1）没用的模块还在仓库里，编译报错、白标残留； 2）更麻烦的是——下载完不知道下一步该干嘛。 密钥去哪拿？支付怎么测？上线前要检查什么？域名在哪买？搜索引擎怎么收录？ 每一步都要自己去搜，搜到的还是三年前的答案。 3)支付和 SEO 的坑没人告诉你，我第一次接支付被 creem 拒审，不知道到底怎么回事。 所以这个模板把「生成代码」和「带你上线」做在了一起。 [特色一：10 步上线向导，专治「不知道干什么」] 下载后运行 npm run setup:wizard，本地打开一个页面，按顺序走： 1. 环境检测 —— 检测 Node/npm/git 和服务商 CLI；缺什么，直接生成一段「让 Agent 去装」的提示词 2. 密钥与获取位置 —— 两个一级标签：服务商配置 / 支付配置；每个密钥去哪拿、控制台链接、当前是否已填 还能顺手创建 /admin 的管理员账号（用户名 + 12 位密码 + 自动生成的会话密钥） 3. 让 Agent 开始干活 —— 一段提示词，已经自动填好你选的支付方式/功能模块/登录方式，你只填一个 4. 上线前手动测试 —— 按你选的支付方式生成：Stripe 测试卡/拒付卡、Waffo 沙盒验签+重放、Creem 测试下单、PayPal 退款、Lemon Squeezy custom data 5. 技术 SEO 预检 —— 提示词调用工程自带 SEO 技能：预渲染、robots、sitemap、canonical/hreflang、JSON-LD、301/404、Core Web Vitals 6. 合规检测 —— 调用合规技能，核对支付网关义务 + 隐私/数据留存，输出「要求 / 状态 / 证据 / 待修」 7. 部署上线 —— 提示词里已经写好你的部署目标（Vercel 等），要求部署后核实线上：首页/pricing 200、webhook 拒绝未签名请求、邮件与定时任务已配置 8. 域名申请 —— 6 家注册商外链 + 优缺点对比（Cloudflare / Porkbun / Namecheap / GoDaddy / Squarespace / 阿里云腾讯云），买完怎么配 DNS 也写了 9. SEO 优化 —— 站内问题自查 10. Google 收录与流量 —— 一键跳转 Search Console 提交 sitemap、复制 sitemap 地址、请求编入索引，外加获取流量的具体动作 ![引导界面](https://i.ibb.co/LXfwxcpd/20261120235950-1302-1.png) 关键点：**每一步给的是一段提示词，复制给 Agent 就行**，不是让你一行行敲命令。 向导还随包附一份 ai/scenario.md：这个产品是给谁的、已经有什么、接下来 5 步、以及「明确没做的东西」——Agent 不能拿不存在的功能给你打勾。 [特色二：按你选的模块真剪枝] 支付（Waffo / Stripe / Creem / PayPal / Lemon Squeezy）、AI（对话 / RAG / 图像 / TTS / 转写 / 视频）、 用户控制台、运营后台、5 种语言、16 套主题。 没勾的模块从源码里删掉，不是 feature flag 关掉。 [特色三：每个组合都在 CI 里真编译] 25 种配置矩阵，逐个生成 ZIP → 解压 → tsc → next build。不是"我们测过"，是每个配置都测。 [特色四：后台能真用] 用户/授权/订单、第一方流量漏斗（真实事件，Cookie 同意后才记录）、AI 用量配额、 审计日志、Webhook 重放、模型路由与价格表；案例墙：投稿 → 审核 → 首页展示 → 发放优惠。 [特色五：质量门禁写死] npm run verify:done：typecheck + 单测 + 五语一致性 + Agent 契约 + 生产构建，全过才打印回执。 npm run verify:prod：上线前强卡——还在用本地 SQLite、占位域名、弱管理员密码、支付没配、邮件是 none，直接拒绝部署。 [不适合谁（写在前面）] - 想「一键上线、完全不碰代码」的：这不是。 - 想视频一键出成片的：管线给的是有序片段清单，合成 MP4 要自己上 ffmpeg worker。 - 想本地用 Docker 跑数据库的：本地是 SQLite，零安装；生产必须接 Supabase（门禁会拦）。 - 要 SMTP 的：现在只有 Resend / webhook / 空实现。 ![生成 saas 效果图](https://i.ibb.co/DHh8kxK6/20261120235847-1301-1-1.png) [价格] Core $99（划线 $149），Studio $149（多视频/图像工作流 + 模型控制台），Care 从 $9/月可选。 **活动价 $69，11/28 截止，站内直接生效，不用优惠码。** [想听的真话] 1. 你当初卡在哪一步？（密钥？支付测试？域名？收录？） 2. 你希望向导里再加什么检查？ 3. 有想看的模块组合，我按你的技术栈现场生成一个 ZIP 给你试。 ![产品首页](https://i.ibb.co/9HxW3rYc/01-landing-cover.png) 链接（带来源方便我看数据）：https://www.make1day.dev/zh?utm_source=v2ex&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch

projects.title: 【开源自荐】Tau：本地优先的个人知识工作台，写作、白板、数据库、知识地图与 AI
projects.author: LastKnightCoder

github.name: LastKnightCoder/editor
github.description: Markdown 编辑器，尝试实现可见即可得

projects.summary: Tau 是一个开源、免费的桌面知识管理软件，数据保存在本地，不需要注册。它把所见即所得的 Markdown 写作、白板、数据库、知识地图和 AI 放在同一个资料库里，内容之间可以互相引用。 起因是我在 Obsidian 里写作时，受不了编辑和预览分开，想要 Typora 那样的所见即所得，于是 2023 年开始自己写编辑器，后来慢慢扩展成了现在的样子。 主要功能： 写作：所见即所得，敲 ## 是标题、> 是引用；斜杠菜单插入表格、代码块、公式、待办等块。也能直接打开电脑上已有的 .md 文件编辑 白板：思维导图、形状、箭头、画框，支持手绘风格，可按画框顺序演示 数据库：同一份数据，表格、看板、画廊、日历四种视图 知识地图：敲 [[ 建立双向链接，所有笔记自动聚成主题，可回放生长过程 阅读与复习：PDF、网页、视频字幕划线并记下出处，闪卡按遗忘曲线复习 AI：接入自己的模型服务后，可基于你的全部笔记问答、查找关联、辅助写作；支持 Skill 与 MCP 日常：番茄钟、待办、日程、日记，汇总到「今日」页 插件：插件可以扩展页面、编辑器块、白板元素和同步存储，例如同步微信读书的划线 发布：勾选卡片和文章，生成静态网站，可发布到 GitHub Pages 或 S3 数据存放在 ~/.editor 下的 SQLite 文件里，随时可以导出 Markdown。 支持 macOS（Apple 芯片 / Intel）、Windows，另有 Android 版。技术栈：Electron + React + TypeScript，SQLite；手机端是 Tauri。

projects.title: Show HN: Custom SQLites for agents (a remote MCP)
projects.author: tukkajukka
projects.summary: What if your agents could create (almost) any SQLite database they need? I built databasedmcp to let Claude (or any other agent) create databases for my sessions, in both Claude and Claude Code. With the MCP, agents can create multiple databases with basically any schema. Docs and tool descriptions: https://databasedmcp.com/docs Some use cases that I've discovered: * Share data between agents Let agents store their status, what they're working on, etc. This is essentially about passing data between coding agents. E.g. set up a worker agent that picks up work items that other agents add to the database. This kind of enables autonomous work discovery. * Build custom apps I've built many ad-hoc apps just by describing the idea to Claude. Ask it to create the UI as an artifact and to use databasedmcp as the backend. Artifacts can call MCP tools however they want. You use the chat to modify the app, and use the app itself in the artifact UI. Pretty easy to build small apps such as a shopping list, an expense tracker, etc. Then use Claude to extract data from documents, and store the data with databasedmcp in a structured manner. Any comments are appreciated, thanks!

projects.title: Show HN: Ripcloc – cloc every edit your agent makes
projects.author: kevsten
projects.summary: Hey HN. ripcloc exists because I ask agents to consider line cost in feedback early and often when they're doing work to help constrain unnecessary complexity and to trigger discussions about code smells that lead to bad architecture. It is fast enough that you can add it to a git commit hook. It is fast enough that your agent harness can run it after every tool call. The other reason it exists is to help _count your tests_. Ripcloc attributes each line as either a source line, a test line or a comment/doc line, so that you can have a better idea quickly how much your codebase is _implementation_ vs _tests_. It does this even for inline tests like `#[cfg(test)] mod tests { ... }` in Rust (and is still faster than its predecessors!).

projects.title: Show HN: It's now easy to install Linux on an Android Phone – Android2linux
projects.author: brazukadev

github.name: android2linux/android2linux
github.description: Turn an Android phone into a Linux pocket computer you control: guides, an agent skill, phone notes, scripts and apps for postmarketOS and Ubuntu Touch.

projects.summary: Hey HN! One of my biggest dreams (really) was to have a Linux phone. I tried to install on some phones in the past, even the ones that would be marked as compatible and it was always so difficult that I couldn't really do it. Yesterday I decided to try again, this time using Claude to do most of the work. A couple hours later it runs postmarketOS as my second phone: 4G, SMS, a terminal, SSH. It took two fixes. U-Boot didn't recognise my phone model, so I patched 14 bytes of its device-tree match strings. Then the modem wasn't working, because the packaged TFTP server that lends the modem a folder mishandled its file-size queries but an upstream build fixed it. The repo is what came out of it: guides for any phone (but specific just for my xiaomi), an agent skill that follows the same method and safety rules, notes per phone, and web apps reworked for a phone screen (WhatsApp Web for desktop with a one-pane layout). What doesn't work (in this phone of mine): no charger driver yet (slow charging), no cameras, and no banking apps, so I keep an Android at home for those. Whether this works for you depends on your phone having a port. reports through the issue forms help, especially for phones that don't work yet. I think that finally succeeding at having a Linux phone is worth creating a post on HN. I was thinking about a Tell HN but decided to convert the knowledge into a repo so more people can share, discuss, add their phones, new apps, etc. Hope it helps!

projects.summary: aist 是一款纯 Go 编写、零配置融入原生 Shell 的轻量级 AI 运维排障智能体，适用于日常服务器排障与多机协同运维场景。支持多轮交互、单次提问及 cmd | aist 管道流只读分析，直接复用系统 ssh 与 ~/.ssh/config 实现跨主机排障（远端免装 Agent），并内置本地结构化环境记忆（Memory），自动沉淀主机拓扑与非标路径。 亮点 极致轻量与零凭据暴露：客户端仅 ~10MB 纯静态单文件、零运行时依赖，终端不存任何 API Key；直接复用系统 ssh 与 ~/.ssh/config，零私钥接触且远端免装 Agent。 安全护栏与文件编辑：内置 Shell AST 语法树拦截、「查询一次确认、修改二次确认」分级护栏，以及彩色 Diff 预览 + 本地自动镜像备份的安全文件编辑能力。 私有化自建与环境记忆：服务端为 42MB 单容器镜像（内嵌 SQLite 零外部依赖），支持 5 分钟私有化自建与多模型优先级冷却自动回退；内置本地结构化环境记忆（Memory），自动沉淀主机拓扑与非标路径。

projects.summary: 阮老师好，自荐一个我们在真实企业交付中沉淀并开源（MIT 协议）的中文 Agent 技能库：dayan-enterprise-ai-skills。 它是什么：一套兼容 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex CLI 与腾讯 WorkBuddy 的 SKILL.md 实战技能包（共 66 枚），聚焦中文商业成稿、招投标与合同风控、企业知识库架构以及实体行业算账诊断。 为什么要做这个库： 我在成都创立了一家做企业 AI 落地的“一人公司（OPC）”。过去一年给工厂、外贸、连锁和服务型企业做方案与内训时，最深的体会是：裸调大模型做个人玩具很惊艳，但一进真实商业场景就会撞上三堵墙： 1. 中文机器腔太重：写出来的汇报和方案满篇“赋能、抓手、闭环、排比三连”，没法直接发给客户和老板； 2. 自审同温层：同一个会话刚写完代码、合同或标书，顺手让它检查，90% 只会轻飘飘回一句没问题，漏掉无限连带赔偿或 ★ 号废标项； 3. 重概念轻呈现：吐出几千字纯文本没人看，用 Mermaid 画复杂中文架构图经常挤字压线。 所以我们把内部每天高频在用的 66 套作业规范脱敏拆了出来，核心不在“提示词话术”，而在几条写死在技能里的工程约束： 生成者与只读审查官分离：例如 dayan-bid-scoring-loop（投标技术方案）强制拆成写手与只读模拟评委逐项打分找扣分点；dayan-contract-4way-audit 从交付、财务、法务、销售四个视角并行挑刺并给出可直接替换的条款文本；dayan-code-adversary 在只读状态下用破坏者、半年后新人、安全戍边三副反方眼镜审代码变更。 中文去 AI 腔五类病灶库（dayan-humanize-pro）：专门针对中文语境清理空洞拔高词、工整四字三连、架空动词与破折号滥用，强制走“草稿 → 换脑挑残留破绽 → 净稿”三段式改写。 零外部依赖单文件交付（dayan-business-html / dayan-svg-diagram）：内置一套 #1B365D 深蓝印刷感单文件 HTML 高管看板母版（等宽数字、防孤字换行表格）与手算坐标 SVG 架构图规范，发进微信或飞书点开即读。 兜错优先的企业知识库蓝图（dayan-rag-guardrail-kb）：按“权限预过滤 → 责任人签字定权威版 → 价格/制度超期熔断 → 原文模糊接地四态兜错”设计，宁可诚实留白不瞎编报价。 实体经营算账工具：包含 13 周滚动现金流断流压测、应收款分级催收、采购核价拆解，以及制造 8D 客诉报告、工程签证防核减、餐饮单店真实毛利核算等垂直场景。 已知边界说明： SKILL.md 本质是给智能体注入结构化作业契约、反例红线与交付母版，能解决单次任务的方法论与排版纪律；但涉及真实招投标资质原件核验、正式法律签署、跨系统幂等写入等高风险生产环节，技能内均强制标注了人工复核停手点，不能替代确定性后端代码与人工终审。 快速体验： bash 使用 skills CLI 按需或全量安装（自动适配 Claude Code / Cursor / Codex） npx -y skills add Kosmoray/dayan-enterprise-ai-skills 或克隆仓库执行本地安装脚本 git clone cd dayan-enterprise-ai-skills && bash install.sh GitHub 在线关键词检索页： 官网介绍与案例： 我是项目作者雷可扬，欢迎各位同行和朋友试用挑刺！

projects.summary: 一个 AI 舰队组织，训出了全球第二的开源决策模型。开源的不止是模型，还有这个组织本身。 这支舰队训出的结构化决策模型，据公开的第三方决策模型评测榜 JevBench，截至 11 月 19 日，在 243 个开源权重系统中能力分排第 2，中国团队第一。模型卡 《AI 舰队手册》记下了岗位怎样分工、什么条件下可以拍板，以及这些规矩为什么改过。五章手册与九个可安装技能都采用 MIT 许可。 亮点 值班岗有来历。项目经理总要停下手里的事，去盯在跑的任务、查状态，便提议设值班岗。新岗位接手后，大部分例行查询交给了程序。第一章 记下了这次分工变化。 授权可以修改。一类反复等人拍板的决定，后来交给岗位在约定条件下处理。两位 AI 还对价值观初稿提出异议，推动修订了判断权条款，经过见第五章。 拿自己的项目就能试。挑一个影响下一位接手者的决定，把依据、验收人、退回条件留下来。下一轮接手者能否说清为什么这么定，是一次具体的检验。

projects.summary: Click a webpage element, describe what to change, and copy your note with its CSS selector into Codex or another coding assistant. Element Picker is an open-source Chrome extension with an interactive demo you can try without installing it.

projects.title: [开源] 牵丝 Filaxis：给 AI Agent 用的远程执行运行时（SDK / CLI / MCP），附多跳 SSH 堡垒机 + Docker 对照实测
projects.author: Corolin
projects.summary: 最近把自己在 Agent 项目里打磨了几套远程执行方案后沉淀出来的一层运行时开源了，叫 **牵丝 Filaxis**（Apache-2.0，TypeScript 实现，支持 Bun / Node），提供 **SDK、CLI 和 MCP Server** 三种接入方式。 - GitHub：https://github.com/corolin/filaxis - npm：`@syrkos/filaxis` ### 为什么要单独抽出来？ 最初只是想让 Agent 通过 SSH 管远程机器，但真跑起来之后，卡住 Agent 的往往不是 SSH 本身，而是执行链路里的工程细节： - **多层 Shell 转义翻车**：比如 `Windows PowerShell -> SSH 堡垒机 -> Linux -> Docker`，引号和转义一多，命令很容易在半路变形。 - **进程与子进程难收敛**：发了 `kill` 之后，远端进程树或后台子进程是否真正退出，缺乏可靠核实。 - **长时任务断线难接管**：命令跑得久、连接抖动或 Agent 会话重连时，状态容易丢。 - **Docker bind-mount 文件替换风险**：直接做普通原子替换，有时会碰上挂载点 / inode 相关的坑。 - **输出混流与上下文淹没**：stdout/stderr 混在一起，长日志把上下文撑爆，Agent 却拿不到明确的终态判断。 于是把这些拆成了几块能力：多层连接、长时会话观察、断线接管、终态核实、CAS 文件编辑、跨层批次任务，以及带校验的文件传输。 ### 跟裸 SSH 实际比过吗？ 做过四期受控对照测试，不光看单条命令延迟，更看端到端排障与文件传输的整体表现。 最近一轮在**同一模型 + 四套独立 Docker-in-Docker 沙盒**下对比了四组： - 原生 SSH - Filaxis CLI - Filaxis SDK - Filaxis MCP 链路设定为：从 Windows 出发，经过跨地域堡垒机（**禁用 TCP Forwarding，不能走 ProxyJump**）进入远端 Linux 与目标 Docker 容器。Agent 事先不知道容器名和故障文件路径，需要自行排查并修复 **9 处隐藏联动故障**，同时完成跨地域二进制文件上传、下载与 SHA-256 校验。 四组均通过验收。其中 **裸 SSH vs Filaxis MCP** 的一轮采样结果如下： | 指标 | 裸 SSH | Filaxis MCP | |---|---:|---:| | 完成耗时 | 483 秒 | 225 秒 | | 决策轮数 | 24 | 14 | | 活跃 Token | 107,151 | 81,297 | | 执行报错/摩擦 | 4 | 0 | 这轮 MCP 的耗时下降了 53.4%，活跃 Token 减少 24.1%。 需要说明的是，这只是单次受控实战采样，不是所有场景的普适结论。在路径明确、步骤很短的简单局域网任务里，裸 SSH 反而可能在 Token 和轮数上更省。完整的测试方法、各组数据、失败记录和局限性都在仓库的 `benchmark.md` 里。 ### 目前支持什么 & 快速上手 核心能力包括： - 多跳 SSH / Docker 进入与跨层批次编排 - 长时会话观察、断线后会话接管、终态核实 - CAS 文件编辑与带校验的文件传输 - MCP Server 接口，可直接接入支持 MCP 的 Agent 宿主 全局安装与查看 MCP 配置： ```bash npm install -g @syrkos/filaxis filaxis mcp-config ``` ### 当前边界 目前还是 `0.2.x` 阶段，**不是全平台生产级通用执行器**。Docker / K8s 等场景目前主要通过进入命令或适配接口接入，部分交互模式与 tmux watcher 接管仍有边界，欢迎在 issue 或讨论里一起踩坑、拍砖。 如果刚好折腾过 Agent 远程运维/排障，欢迎试用交流；如果觉得有点参考价值，也欢迎点个 Star ⭐ https://github.com/corolin/filaxis 千里一线，执行有迹。

projects.title: Pippin
projects.summary: Keeping a to-do list should not feel like a second job. Pippin takes all the work out of keeping a todo list, from creating tasks to updating them to closing them, you don't have to lift your finger to do anything. Pippin turns email, chat, docs, anything on your Mac screen into tasks and keeps them up-to-date. Pippin categorises tasks by itself into categories. Forgot what you did three days ago? Ask Pippin in chat. Want to use pippin just as a memory layer? Hook your AI agent to it's MCP.

projects.title: Supero
projects.summary: Your AI writes the interface and data models. Supero runs everything behind it: sign-in and SSO, tenant isolation, roles and field rules, workflows that undo on failure, 40+ integrations, generated APIs and SDKs, and deployment. Connect Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT or VS Code over MCP. Keep your database (PostgreSQL, Supabase, Snowflake and more) or start on ours. Access rules are applied by the runtime on every request, with no LLM in the request path. Free plan, no card needed.

projects.title: Dawnroom
projects.summary: Dawnroom is an open-source image studio that runs on your own GPU. Describe an image, get an image. Describe a change, and it edits the rest untouched. Auto mode picks a model that fits your machine, 34 open models are in the library, and nothing leaves your computer. Use the Windows Studio, the CLI, a localhost OpenAI-compatible API, or an MCP server so Claude Code and Codex can generate images for you.

projects.title: 【资源自荐】Anagnoraxis 的 AI 实践教程、Muse2API 与访谈阅读笔记
projects.author: 7yedeng

github.name: 7yedeng/mcpx-web-local-guide
github.description: 用 MCPX 让 Claude / ChatGPT 网页操作 Windows：图文教程、前置条件、SOP 与来源说明。作者与 AI 共同整理。

projects.summary: 我是 Anagnoraxis 的维护者。下面是本人在 AI 协助下整理、已公开发布的工具、教程和阅读资料，自荐供周刊选用。各项的来源、实现范围和待验证事项均在原文中列明。 1. 让 Claude / ChatGPT 网页操作 Windows：MCPX 图文教程 Windows 下使用 MCPX 的图文指南，包含 HTTPS/OAuth、文件与命令工具、验证和恢复步骤，附脱敏截图、配置示例与 SOP。配套指南仓库。MCPX 软件属于上游项目；这里自荐的是指南，不代表所有网页端账号均具备相同权限。 2. Muse2API 开源：把 Muse 接进自己的 API 工作流 开源仓库：面向本人已获授权 Muse 会话的单用户社区适配器，提供文字、图片理解、生图编辑和异步视频接口，附部署文档、会话加密持久化、Skill 与完整 AI 执行提示词。无 Meta 官方背书，不扩大账号权益或配额；离线工程测试与真实账号、媒体及中转链路验收分开记录。仓库也说明了上游早期参考链的许可信息缺口。 3. 一台 VPS，让智能体完成个人代理部署 面向全新专用 Ubuntu 24.04 VPS 的部署方法与工具包，包含主机预检、依赖锁定、私密配置、验收及回退；完整 AI 提示词可单独阅读。已有本地测试，真实 VPS、公网 UDP 与长期运行表现需另行验收。 4. 会话凭据转换器 将本人已获授权且仍有效的 ChatGPT 会话内容，在浏览器本地整理为 Cookie-Editor 可导入的 JSON。不上传输入，只整理格式，不创建订阅权益；使用前需理解登录凭据的敏感性。这里链接的是公开介绍页。 5. 先给你的职业加上 AI：Dario Amodei 访谈阅读笔记 原创阅读笔记，整理十章阅读范围、八组职业问题、原片时间索引与实践清单，区分访谈观点、作者理解和待验证问题。附原片来源及文本下载，不是访谈逐字稿或官方翻译。 主站：Anagnoraxis。以上以技术资料和阅读资源投稿，供编辑按内容适配选用。

projects.title: 【工具自荐】CleanBit：Mac App Store 沙盒内的透明磁盘清理工具（针对 Xcode / node_modules / AI 编程工具）
projects.author: Ceelog
projects.summary: CleanBit 是我做的一款运行在 Mac App Store 沙盒里的原生 macOS（15+）磁盘清理工具，用 SwiftUI 开发，不需要 root 权限，也没有常驻后台守护进程。 做它的初衷很简单：开发用 Mac 上最占空间的往往不是系统垃圾，而是 Xcode 的 DerivedData / 旧 iOS DeviceSupport、几十个旧项目里的 nodemodules / target / .build，以及 Claude Code、Codex 这些 AI 编程工具留下的会话日志和旧版本。传统清理工具经常一键打包成“系统垃圾”，点下去之前不知道会删什么；或者需要关闭沙盒、装后台 helper。 CleanBit 把所有扫描项拆成三档，删除前每项都写明是什么、删了会有什么影响，你确认之前什么都不删： 1. 建议清理（可自动重建的缓存）：Xcode DerivedData、保留最新 2 个版本的旧 DeviceSupport、已关机模拟器内部缓存（保留模拟器内已装 App 与数据）、npm/uv/Cargo/Homebrew/SwiftPM 等包管理器缓存、浏览器缓存（不碰 Cookie、历史与登录态）、Claude Code 旧版本与 Claude 桌面版缓存；正在运行的应用缓存自动锁定不可选。 2. 需要确认（默认不勾选，删时一律移到废纸篓）：nodemodules / .build / target / .venv / Pods 等项目构建产物（扫描 ~/.claude/worktrees、~/.codex/worktrees 与常规项目目录，并解析 .git 索引跳过被 Git 跟踪的内容）、Claude Code / Codex 旧 .jsonl 会话（不碰 memory/）、Downloads 里的旧安装包、已卸载应用残留与手动勾选的文件。 3. 仅展示（不可删除）：Hugging Face / Ollama / LM Studio / PyTorch 本地模型权重、pnpm store、Docker 虚拟磁盘镜像——只帮你看清它们占了多少 GB，避免误删。 在一台开发用 Mac 上实测，项目 nodemodules 占了 66.3 GB（304 个），CoreSimulator/Devices 占了 43.0 GB，iOS DeviceSupport 占了 24.1 GB，DerivedData 占了 15.3 GB；引擎智能扫描大约 7.4 秒扫描出 124.29 GB，其中建议清理约 66.43 GB。 也坦诚说明沙盒的边界：它只读取你授权的个人文件夹（废纸篓、Safari 等容器需按需开启完全磁盘访问），不碰 APFS 本地快照、/private/tmp 或系统底层目录，也不做“加速 Mac”或内存释放；iCloud Drive 同步文件会主动拦截，提示在 Finder 中处理。 价格方面：扫描免费，提供 2 次免费清理；后续按月订阅、年订阅或一次性买断（终身版）均可（具体价格以各区 App Store 显示为准）。

projects.title: 开源了一个纯本地桌面工具 Mingle：没有服务器，把你的 AI Agent 请进微信、飞书、Slack 等聊天软件
projects.author: earyu
projects.summary: 最近做了一个 MIT 开源的本地桌面工具 **Mingle**，可以把你电脑上的 AI Agent（Claude Code、Codex、Kimi Code、OpenCode、Cursor 等 14 种 harness）以机器人身份请进你平时已经在用的聊天软件里。 ### 为什么再造一个：核心是不想有服务器 现在支持接自家 coding agent 的工具已经不少，但我自己用下来最介意的一点是**云端中转**——只要有第三方服务器兜底，聊天记录和工作上下文就得过别人的机房，既存在服务端被黑客攻击拖库的风险，也没法彻底排除厂商拿数据干别的。 所以 Mingle 从一开始就做成**零服务器、纯本地运行**： - 没有 Mingle 服务端，没有账号体系，没有遥测。 - 直接走各聊天软件的官方机器人接口连回本机（iMessage 走本机 Apple ID），不经过云端桥接。 - 控制台和 API 只监听 `127.0.0.1`；机器人凭据只存在系统钥匙串（macOS Keychain / Windows DPAPI / Linux Secret Service）。 - Agent 的角色和记忆就是本机目录里的 `ROLE.md`、`MEMORY.md`、`notes/`。如果电脑关机后也想让它 24 小时在线，支持在界面里一键部署到你自己的 SSH 主机上。 ### 用下来比较顺手的几个点 1. **一个 Agent，跨 IM 同一份记忆** 支持微信、企业微信、飞书、钉钉、QQ、Slack、Discord、Telegram、iMessage 以及 GitHub Issues/PR。同一个 Agent 同时待在你的飞书工作群、微信群和 Discord 里，记忆是打通的——在微信里问它“今天上午飞书群里定了什么”，它直接答得出来。 2. **更像群友的群聊体验** 这几天重点打磨了群聊消息投递：它能旁听群里对话，直接叫它名字或外号就能接话，不用每句都 @；忙群会自动降频，没必要时不乱插话也省额度；飞书还支持在文档评论里 @ 它回复。 3. **并行干活不卡聊** 交给它一件耗时任务（写代码、查资料、跑命令）时，它在后台开支线跑，照样正常回复其他人。飞书、Slack、Discord 里会直接在你的消息下面开话题同步进度，做完再把结果回主群。 4. **对话记忆一键交接** 可以把你在 Claude Code / Codex 里已经聊了一半的进展和偏好，一键交接给 Mingle 里的 Agent 接着干。 ![Mingle 控制台](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/earayu/Mingle/main/site/img/agent-zh-light.png) ### 当前状态（提前说清） 项目是上周四起意开写的，目前迭代到 `v0.4.8`，仍处于早期阶段： - Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Kimi Code 已端到端跑通； - 飞书在真实租户上验证过，其余聊天软件目前是对着平台接口和测试验证的； - 提供 macOS / Windows / Linux 桌面安装包和一键安装脚本。macOS 版已过 Apple 签名公证，Windows 版还没签名。 - GitHub： https://github.com/earayu/Mingle - 官网： https://mingle.build/zh/ 欢迎各位 V 友试用和拍砖，如果遇到接入某个 IM 踩坑或者有想要的功能，直接在 GitHub 提 Issue 就好。

projects.author: LiMingHuaGit

github.name: LiMingHuaGit/ming-skill-analyzer
github.description: Analyze any Agent Skill and generate an interactive 3-panel HTML report with dynamic SVG flowchart. MIT license, Python 3.10+ stdlib only.

projects.summary: ming-skill-analyzer 是一个面向 AI Agent Skill 作者的分析工具，输入一个 Skill 目录，输出一份带动态 SVG 流程图的三栏交互式 HTML 报告。 随着 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编程工具的普及，越来越多的开发者在编写自定义 Skill（指令集）来扩展 Agent 能力。但「写完一个 Skill 之后，很难知道 Agent 是怎么理解和执行它的」——这个工具就是为了解决这个问题。 核心特点 确定性扫描：只读文件，不执行任何代码，输出可复现的 facts.json 证据溯源：每条分析结论必须追溯到源文件的具体行号，不允许无来源推断 质量验证：--strict 模式输出三项可量化指标（证据覆盖率 ≥90%、推断比例、无来源声明数 = 0） 动态流程图：SVG 有向图，支持泳道、播放动画、能力筛选、全屏 零依赖：Python 3.10+ 标准库，git clone 即可使用 自验证 工具本身也用自己分析了自己（自指分析），通过了 100% 证据覆盖率的严格验证。落地页上展示的流程图和能力说明直接来自那份分析报告，不是手写文案。

projects.title: Show HN: ArkViz – AI generated software architecture diagrams
projects.author: bofia
projects.summary: Hi HN, I’m Bryant, founder of ArkViz ( https://arkviz.io ). ArkViz is a product to automatically generate architecture diagrams from your codebase using AI. The vision behind ArkViz is to supercharge both AI agents and humans by providing AI agents deeper relational context using structured model diagram formats, and by providing humans with a rich visual representation you can interact with, with features like zooming, panning, search, and show composing files. In this new age of AI, you can generate a structured model diagram from your codebase in seconds, quicker and better than a human. Not only can the generated diagram be a visual documentation tool for humans, AI agents can also benefit from the context of a pre-generated architecture diagram that lives alongside a project’s codebase. This concept has already been proven by context files like CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, ARCHITECTURE.md living in the root of your repository. The differentiator between ARCHITECTURE.md and ArkViz is that ArkViz generates a structured model diagram of the system, while ARCHITECTURE.md is broader in scope and purely text. ArkViz aims to be a supplement to ARCHITECTURE.md to provide deeper understanding like how components are connected, which components live inside other components, which files compose a component. — Why ArkViz? Software engineering teams often create diagrams to aid in the documentation of their software systems. They are incredibly useful for onboarding new engineers and understanding projects. However, they take time to create and maintain, so are often non-existent or out of date. ArkViz automates the creation and maintenance of software architecture diagrams, seamlessly and securely. AI agents thrive when they have high quality context, including for architecture diagrams. However not all diagram formats out there are optimized for AI. A diagram showing connected systems and components can be represented in essentially 3 ways: 1. Unstructured drawing / canvas format (e.g. draw.io, Excalidraw, Figma, LucidChart) - Quick to get started but hard to maintain. - Good for brainstorming and whiteboarding - The format carries no semantic meaning and is basically represented by pixels, shapes, and vectors. Positioning is stored - Passing this to an AI agent as context has questionable value. 2. Structured diagramming formats (e.g. Mermaid, d2lang) - A level of abstraction higher than a 2D drawing canvas - Good for quick isolated diagram, like on GitHub - Represented by nodes and edges, nested hierarchies. Layout is generated - Better for AI agents, although they have to piece together the context, and might get confused by an inconsistency like duplicate naming 3. Structured modeling formats (e.g. Structurizr, LikeC4, IcePanel). - These have an underlying data model and single source of truth - High quality documentation, but hard to create and maintain - Represented by entities and relationships. Layout can be richer, like zooming into a component and seeing what's inside - Best for AI agents, since they have a single source of truth context ArkViz currently uses LikeC4 for its diagram format, a modern, popular, and open-source architecture-as-code format that supports interactive diagrams. AI agents will be more trained with this than a proprietary format. Why not roll my own solution with something like Claude Code? While Claude Code is a powerful AI coding harness, ArkViz provides seamless features you'd rather not spend time building like hosting diagrams, access control, scheduling automation, handling errors and retries, logs, connectors to GitHub. Additionally, ArkViz has battle-tested, optimized multi-pass prompts, validators, and guardrails for the specific purpose of AI generated architecture diagrams. Take a look here: https://arkviz.io ! Feedback greatly appreciated on which features you care about, and whether you think the value proposition is there.

projects.title: Show HN: Accounting built like Git, with files in your own storage
projects.author: oskar77
projects.summary: Lots of ways to do your accounting today with LLMs, but for some reason there is this expectation you are suppose to keep the old accounting software around? And it sort of makes sense, they vouch for the ledger integrity and keep the audit trail. It reminded me of how things where like before git. You trusted the host not just to keep the data but to vouch for the versioning, and what git really did was move that last part into the data itself. Accounting ledgers need integrity, in fact it is mandated by law in most places. Git buys integrity by publishing, because if you do not share your repo with anyone, you can always force push and rewrite the commit history and no-one would know. But your books are sensitive and cannot be published. So I made git-style versioning for double-entry accounting. Entries gets hashed and timestamped, service checks for debit equals credit, and it ends up as json files you keep in your own S3 bucket. Not in a vendor database. For the hosted version the access keys to the buckets are encrypted with the user passkey / assistant OAuth, so the service cannot read anything at-rest. For user convenience there is a hosted version where you do the books through MCP on whatever LLM you already use. The whole thing is so cheap to run, because the service does not store any sensitive data, so it is free, although you need an AI client with MCP support and an S3 bucket. Hosted version: https://bobalice.com Code walkthrough: https://bobalice.com/docs/alice

projects.title: [开源推荐] 把「agent 回答跑偏」变成能改的清单：读聊天记录，指出该改提示词还是该微调
projects.author: agent-mcocdaa

github.name: agent-mcocdaa/tavern-output-diagnose
github.description: 把「agent/酒馆回答怎么调都不顺心」变成能改的清单：读一份聊天记录，指出哪几条跑偏、偏成哪一类、该先改提示词还是该微调。

projects.title: Show HN: erXos – a microkernel OS in Erlang based on Genera/Plan 9/QNX ideas
projects.author: stass
projects.summary: What if every Erlang process were an operating-system process? With as much system code and drivers written in Erlang itself. This is something I was pondering for a while, and finally was able to prototype thanks to AI coding agents. erXos is a capability-based microkernel OS in Erlang: drivers, filesystems, and the network stack are all supervised Erlang processes, same as any app. The kernel itself is Fiasco, in C++, slightly modified for erXos needs. This is an OS I wanted for a long time: an Erlang machine where every BEAM process is a process visible to the OS and scheduler, not something bolted on top. You can try it right now with nothing to install: there is an emulator on the website that boots the whole OS in the browser ARM64 emulator. At the rc prompt, try `ps`, `top`, `ping` or `erl` and write any kind of erlang code. There's a Pi 4 SD image and a QEMU image too. The goal is to build an ultra-reliable microkernel OS with hot code loading and both system and BEAM-based isolation. The latter is one thing that would allow you to run millions of processes on the system, something that would be prohibitive on a microkernel alone due to the context switch overhead. Capabilities keep every component least-privileged, supervision keeps the machine running when drivers or subsystems crash, and hot code loading would let you fix a broken driver without reboot. The secondary goal is to keep as much of a UNIX face as possible. Too many novel OSes change things for no particular reason that makes them hard to use. erXos tries to preserve as many existing UNIX/FreeBSD concepts as much as possible to remove the learning curve. What works today: - Boots in the browser/v64, in QEMU, and on a Raspberry Pi 4 from an SD card - A real shell (plan9 rc) with job control, pipes, `ps`, `grep`. It feels like UNIX on the surface - Erlang versions of basic UNIX apps. - Drivers written in Erlang: UART, virtio, SD card, Ethernet (GENET), display - A pure Erlang EROFS filesystem for root images - A TCP/IP stack in Erlang based on FreeBSD network stack and verified for correctness against it - Domains: every app runs as its own address space or Erlang node, isolated from others - Plan 9 namespaces and 9P everywhere; windows are files like RIO and 9P is a file protocol between OS servers - Supervision end to end: if a driver fails, its supervisor resets the device and restarts it I also have 2 demo apps built on app sdk: a full-screen kiosk app with live crypto quotes and clock and, of course Doom, which ships on the Pi 4 card image (type `doom`). What's coming: - Raspberry Pi 5 support - Full display on the Pi - WIFI - Bluetooth - POSIX-lite for C programs, so existing code can run as a domain - Performance, debugging and tracing features. The code is all available under the BSD license. Would love to hear all and any feedback!
